Fellow American,

As a Hispanic female running for Congress in Texas, I have a message for First Lady Jill Biden: **We’re more than just “breakfast tacos” as you described us today in a speech you gave in San Antonio.**

We’re Americans, just like you. **We’re not a one size fits all culture like you and your party like to believe**. Your snafu highlights the reason your husband and his Democrat allies in Congress are losing the support of Hispanics like me in droves. You guys in D.C. like to think that we’re all alike. We’re not.

[**THIS IS WHAT A REPUBLICAN LOOKS LIKE** ](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9022e6d2f8334b6fbdf1d2c1b4840f94&_e=nZ0Zj9BFnJxUo2GQwivz9xx62aKyxZACoV-qi3fk8CggZiSFOCBRuZKdyp6l2KznafFQXlmHxK1c_MKtZNssYSHX8eqWQi1LNYM5qZJn09mPU7pwWkG5qc4mOytpBtIWF2Lem5ZD0BMsTujLIXK7p9U_VM4CyDNPUCcD3NuNdgwKARpvdt3UASNFP1vsfwDudawJEIP_NV4RU32Mkj1eilv1y1ptltKf_G0Sprv9v5qfbs8aV8Er9ehvqvvOYjqEquG6LgnKTkvX2rP2ezD7sydO0gNYlK4jsN_zhJXcee3tSVrCJHshICzC_sSjuOe9Ben8t230_11SFQSAsF6wXCU__OM2Y0Cv9u0i8OABHtOmxMX7sq8N30OdTxkSja08on5cEM6i8jq-SJrCXc0v66CGYUHXtZGulie5GLCKDJo1k4zR6UDewzCG8fhiY_5ZlvpdwW2Wm72zCgdETlQcUTAhuQuOd1N2ZeisQsE32Hw%3D)
We’re nothing like you think we are. **We believe in God. We believe in the right to bear arms. We believe in a strong familial unit. We believe in personal responsibility and accountability**. These are all things neither your husband nor his party believes in. And that’s why this former Democrat left the party to join the Republicans. Your party no longer represents us.

**As a single mother from South Texas who owns her own business, I can attest that breakfast tacos are a delicious breakfast - particularly convenient for those of us who have no time to sit down and eat a full breakfast at the White House**.

To anyone reading this email right now: **[I’d like to send First Lady Jill Biden some of South Texas’ best breakfast tacos and I’m asking for you to make a contribution to my congressional campaign today to help me do that](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9022e6d2f8334b6fbdf1d2c1b4840f94&_e=nZ0Zj9BFnJxUo2GQwivz9xx62aKyxZACoV-qi3fk8CggZiSFOCBRuZKdyp6l2KznafFQXlmHxK1c_MKtZNssYSHX8eqWQi1LNYM5qZJn09mPU7pwWkG5qc4mOytpBtIWF2Lem5ZD0BMsTujLIXK7p9U_VM4CyDNPUCcD3NuNdgwKARpvdt3UASNFP1vsfwDudawJEIP_NV4RU32Mkj1eilv1y1ptltKf_G0Sprv9v5qfbs8aV8Er9ehvqvvOYjqEquG6LgnKTkvX2rP2ezD7s9IUi4trti0PIEwtk63xq3DFwUj5v037m9Wzuxe1AAINkVPa7cZmNm-TdZYwxro-3wbiAJUwIVJfk2a0eSfXc5JPRd3HXxNgoPckRJ0ws44TX9N0f2hV4c9sY_MSP-xJepz_amfbZkWtgjqM86vTatzphi_esRFU6DrRL2VxfVf9rohgNjLcK2NGnmlCsBHuZSn3nfYR28uD1peTcAtFjLA%3D)**.

**I’m going to attach a note to the order of tacos letting her know that she’s inspired me to work extra hard now to flip my South Texas congressional district red for the first time since 1903**.

[** CHIP IN $3
SEND A BREAKFAST TACO TO JILL BIDEN ➞ **](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=9022e6d2f8334b6fbdf1d2c1b4840f94&_e=nZ0Zj9BFnJxUo2GQwivz9xx62aKyxZACoV-qi3fk8CggZiSFOCBRuZKdyp6l2KznafFQXlmHxK1c_MKtZNssYSHX8eqWQi1LNYM5qZJn09mPU7pwWkG5qc4mOytpBtIWF2Lem5ZD0BMsTujLIXK7p9U_VM4CyDNPUCcD3NuNdgwKARpvdt3UASNFP1vsfwDudawJEIP_NV4RU32Mkj1eilv1y1ptltKf_G0Sprv9v5qfbs8aV8Er9ehvqvvOYjqEquG6LgnKTkvX2rP2ezD7s6R7kW6L3y4YKTJpGbHVagMlStK8Tj5SW5NQ0fUTHf5GBel635n_rkswQ2FtlpteaKtmyJEE-E_HF-rSAapRt8gh6BD1ozPD2yS4nFr7LMqH5DBkBaOiHBh1hKQ8scLXLGxH-G4ZjRHcmzBuO86Ra79ryfNgBhNMQH6213LQVAOAVCqnSJoHPKhurAZsSYlRuE8OJCe9FRPepazvoMtj9oI%3D)

name: Jake Duesenberg
subject: They're Attacking Us Again
body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_re_attacking_us_again&n=1)
---
Peter \-- Well sit down for a few minutes, I have a story to tell you. What happened to President Trump is now happening to us here at Action 4 Liberty. **This is going to be a long but important email. And at the end I’m going to ask for your help.** The Political Class is weaponizing government agencies to attack YOU through Action 4 Liberty - their political opponents - just like they did to President Donald Trump. All the effort and resources you have given to raise up this flag of liberty in Minnesota is being systematically attacked on a massive scale. The Political Class will do anything they can to destroy Patriots like you and me. Including trying to shut us down FOREVER! Normally I wouldn’t send out an email with such dry, technical details but this has gone too far. **The Political Class is out to destroy all our hard work of exposing their corruption and bad votes.** Let me walk you through the details. In 2021, Action 4 Liberty sustained an attack by political foes who put in a frivolous complaint to the Campaign Finance Board (CFB). They claimed we were out of compliance when we sent a team of door knockers up north to pressure legislators to STOP protecting Walz' Emergency Powers. **The CFB staff rightly saw through this garbage - they found in our favor even before it got off the ground.** That's an important point about staff recommendations; I'll circle back around to it in a minute. You see, YOUR political enemies that we fight on your behalf, hire high-priced downtown attorneys to file erroneous complaints against Action 4 Liberty. They do this in an effort to distract us from holding the Radical Left and RINOs accountable and try to bleed us of resources in a backdoor attempt to SILENCE US and close us down. The Political Class is swimming in money because the corrupt politicians use the government to unfairly tilt the playing field towards them giving them windfalls of profits that they in turn use to fund the politicians.
## It’s everything you and I stand against!
This means we are reliant on good, hard-working American Patriots like yourself to keep operations going to hold these people accountable. Let me remind you that your Action 4 Liberty was attacked by:
* **State Fair front office -** trying to silence us by stealing our King Walz sign.
* **Facebook -** Big Tech censors wiped our page clean off the internet after we spent years building it.
* **Reported to the FBI -** for, get this, door knocking homes in a legislator's district during our pressure campaign.

Now a new baseless claim has been tossed out at us and the whole Political Class is salivating to SILENCE US. This is a critical moment for your Action 4 Liberty organization. And why I need your help. **It's like our back is against the wall in a barfight and we're being surrounded on all sides by people ready to sock us in the face.** But we've been here before and have come out bigger and stronger each time. Their claim was that we gave a "corporate contribution" against the rules. Our lawyers sprung into action, clearly showing to the CFB that it was a baseless claim because no contribution occurred. After review by the CFB's lawyer, he saw what was clear as day and drafted a recommendation to the Board to dismiss the claims stating there was no probable cause to continue. If you think the story would end there you are wrong. Like Trump said...
# It's a witch hunt!
In a extremely rare act, the CFB rejected the staff attorney's legal recommendation and instead took the political retribution track. The CFB abandoned the allegation that we gave a contribution outright and are now claiming that we didn't charge enough money for services. This wasn't even in the original allegation!!! **By not following their attorney's recommendation and by trying to start a fishing expedition on us, it's clear we are being politically targeted here. And the Political Class, including the Republican Establishment, is cheering it on.** And get this, all the CFB members are Dayton and Walz appointees. Further, this is REPUBLICAN Establishment allies lobbing these political bombs at us. Just think if the Republican Establishment fought this hard against Ending Walz' Emergency Powers instead of attacking Patriots like you and me! Or if they put this energy into GIVING BACK the surplus!
But I refuse to back down. We’ve done nothing wrong and in this great country we should be able to criticize the Political Class without fear of retribution. They’d like nothing more than to get us to fold up now and quit. That won't happen - that’s where I need your help. **_I need you to pitch into our legal fund to keep Action 4 Liberty going and NOT LET THEM SILENCE US._** | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_re_attacking_us_again&n=2 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/a4l_legal_fund?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=they_re_attacking_us_again&n=2)
---
When Governor Walz and Keith Ellison targeted our brave business owners who defied their unlawful orders, we sprung into action. Our hero Jane Moss' Boardwalk Bar & Grill (pictured below) was under attack.
**You stepped up to the plate.**
YOU raised over $23,000 to help her fight against the same type of Political Creatures that are attacking us now.
I need to level with you. This fight is going to cost a lot because we have to go on the legal offense now.
**This could mean lawsuits against shady government actors, injunctions which are expensive and other legal maneuvers to protect what you and I have built.**
So I need you to step up like you've never done before today.
I'm asking you to think of how much you can reasonably give right now that would not change your lifestyle.
For some, that means they can give $1,000 easy. Others, that means $100 without question - all for the cause of pushing back against the Political Class.
**Whatever you can afford RIGHT NOW, please chip in.**

body:
___I wanted to send along a quick update on my work here in Washington, and here’s what I’ve been focusing on the last few weeks._ **_Biden’s open borders agenda._** _President Biden is planning to eliminate Title 42 – Donald Trump’s commonsense policy that allows border patrol officers to deport illegal immigrants more easily. Even_[** _Biden’s administration admits_**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=KVYzWTFUuJ0SsyVZLAg-7KhgymeBWCJ5z6VS6DGe2fJFAdnxGkcJEpWvMWTNR0ClnljL8H6gwcgX-zzjzkI7fxMLKW476dTY9F7NtwLOm_JYodSEG9A8_T2ItHNRJ_rjor7PVSQio1HjU5fkvZkvKQ&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tiffany_border_letter&n=1) _that eliminating this policy could result in 18,000 illegal migrants crossing our border every day – a “mass immigration event”._ _That’s why I’m partnering with several Republican colleagues in the House to introduce_[** _The Border Safety and Security Act_** _._](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=VTmj4rzT2IGTecsX4bEyWFXr9B2jhBRrSrOhymPen87Wd5PksTemXzojtpZsIJQKXya7TCCDdI_9uBAq7uujog5Lv9TNP9qdjIDu8qK6jbBzUasZUtsb6rUTBlZUV0pL&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tiffany_border_letter&n=2)_This legislation would empower border patrol officers to stop illegal border crossings and return illegal migrants to their countries of origin._ **_Biden’s inflation crisis._** _Joe Biden is still refusing to take responsibility for the worst inflation crisis in 40 years. He’s blaming the pandemic, the Ukraine War, “price gouging” at the pump...anything but himself.___ _Even worse, Biden is refusing to pursue policies to increase American oil and gas production, and the consequences have been staggering. For the first time in American history, the average price of gas is over $4 a gallon in all 50 states. President Biden’s blame game isn’t fixing the problem._**_It’s only making things worse._** **_Potential violence from the radical left._** _Last month, a Supreme Court draft opinion that appears to overturn Roe v. Wade was leaked to the media. Not only was this an egregious violation of trust, but it also_ [**_ignited the unruly left-wing protestors_**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=GjwzQmjoNJNKZ7-eUAZR_KUV00uXJCy_qumkH2rEGrGCSv0rhobAsrQo7oArCwPvdY5dSzIJrn8UHJZVxGsnTMi1jROOuZhBWyjCBfGrJIY&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tiffany_border_letter&n=3)** _._**__ _Far-left activists have targeted pro-life organizations and houses of worship with violence and vandalism. They’ve even tried to intimidate Supreme Court justices at their homes. Now, far-left groups are warning of a “summer of rage” if Roe v. Wade is indeed overturned._ _Sadly, the Biden administration is doing very little to discourage this behavior, even when it violates federal law. I, for one, will not be intimidated by violence, and I will continue to stand up for the rights of the unborn._ _Friend, America is going through a tough time right now. That’s why I’m working harder than ever to implement commonsense solutions that will help get our nation back on track._ _Thank you for your continued support. I look forward to bringing you more updates soon._ _Sincerely,_ _Tom Tiffany_ | [](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tiffany_border_letter&n=4 "VOLUNTEER TODAY") [VOLUNTEER TODAY](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=tiffany_border_letter&n=4)

# Dear Peter,

**Without safety, nothing else matters. **

_I have been saying this since the very first day of my campaign._ We have to start by treating criminals like criminals and police like heroes.

**What's happening in Baltimore is unacceptable. Crime is killing the City and is spilling out into communities across the state. **

[**Yesterday I held a press conference in Baltimore to discuss my plan to combat violent crime. **](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=3b41574b69&e=64ac72257a)

| It's time to put an end to the violent crime epidemic in our state.

**We have to fight for the safety of our families and our communities.

_Enough is enough._**

**Will you stand with me to hold prosecutors accountable and put these violent criminals in jail?**

[**Please consider a contribution of $25, $50, $75, $100 or even $250 to help us in our fight.**](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=89dd6cd664&e=64ac72257a)

Crime is killing the City and is spilling out into communities across the state. It's time to put an end to the violent crime epidemic in our state. We have to fight for the safety of our families and our communities. Enough is enough. Will you stand with me to hold prosecutors accountable and put these violent criminals in jail? State of education

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWUgeVChNJ

Hello,
Public
education today is failing our nation's young people-and their
parents.
As each
generation moves on from the public school system, more and more
Americans are growing unaware of our country's great history and
civic traditions.
But
unfortunately, civics and history are too often forgotten or
overlooked in the 21st century. That's why I am committed to
having conversations with thought leaders around the country and
providing educational resources for Americans.
But an
educated citizenry is essential to self-government-and the future
of freedom. That's why I've issued a challenge to patriots like
you to read-or re-read-the Declaration of Independence as part of
our More Perfect Union Project.
Because
this important historical document is so rich with wisdom and
eternal truths, I've asked my team at ACI to put together a
helpful guide that offers a clear and exclusive analysis of this
piece of history.
And I'm
emailing you today to make sure you get a free copy of this
latest eBook: Breaking Down the Declaration.

When you
read this book, you'll discover:

The
historical context surrounding the Declaration of Independence
and why our Founders drafted it
The 3
essential elements of the Declaration and what they meant for the
establishment of our nation
How
many of King George's original offenses are being repeated by our
own government today

You can
get your free copy using this secure link:
https://offers.americancornerstone.org/breaking-down-the-declaration/
And I
hope you'll share it with your family, friends, and anyone you
know in our younger generations.
If we're
going stop history from repeating itself, it is critical that we
educate as many people as possible.
I really
hope you enjoy this book.
Please
use this link to get instant access right now:
https://offers.americancornerstone.org/breaking-down-the-declaration/

Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
American
Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

subject: “One of the most shameful aspects of gerrymandering is that it disproportionately hurts the voting power of communities of color.”

body:
SCOTUS attacks Black voters in southern states
|
---

---
Friend – we’ve been seeing a pattern in southern states. First a court declares that a Republican-drawn map is gerrymandered and should not be used. Then a higher court – in two cases the Trump Supreme Court – _orders the map reinstated_. | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47800831/355709204/1479146301?amount=20&refcode=20220714.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NWZiNDllLTZjMDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JhhHQAoJn5aTC9KlwBXoyAX-qjWwnSz5wUrFZy3tiik=)
---
In all of these cases, the gerrymandered maps disproportionately weaken the political power of Black communities. In fact, earlier this year _The New York Times_ reported that **"Map by Map, GOP Chips Away at Black Democrats' Power."** Combined with conservatives' gutting of the Voting Rights Act over the last decade, it's extremely alarming.

**But we won't give up. We've always known that fair redistricting is a civil rights issue. And that fact only makes it more important to secure fair maps.[Will you help us do it?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47800832/355709205/1479146301?amount=20&refcode=20220714.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA0NWZiNDllLTZjMDMtZWQxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=JhhHQAoJn5aTC9KlwBXoyAX-qjWwnSz5wUrFZy3tiik=)**

Hello,
Growing up in rural Iowa, I thought we were well-to-do because we had a piano, a well-used sewing machine, a big garden, and a flag pole. Our house was small, one bathroom, for a family of ten. I was surprised to know that not every family struggled with affording the $7 meal ticket each kid needed for school.
Lebanon, Iowa, had eight houses, a church, and a small feed store. My life centered on helping my dad, school, and exploring Dry Creek, a wonderland of aquatic life down the hill. The nearest town was Hudson, SD, nine miles west down a gravel road.
We were the prototypical rural Iowa family. Breakfast, lunch, dinner, lunch, then supper kept the house full of aromas. “Read a book,” would be mom’s terse direction if you showed any idleness. It is from this humble beginning, work as a welder, farmhand, then in a slaughterhouse, that brought me into the U.S. Navy.
America must present an opportunity for its citizens to achieve great things. From homemade clothes (I’m the littlest one) to a three-star Admiral is just one such journey. The next step is to use life’s experiences to continue a lifetime of service to this nation and my state of Iowa.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley here in Iowa because I can represent people from all walks of life. My life’s experiences provided an innate understanding for what it means to be a Democrat:_to care as much for those I’ve never met as I do for those I know_. Obviously, Chuck Grassley is not a Democrat; he seems to only care about what Trump and his corporate PAC donors want.**
People like me aren’t supposed to be able to run and win. Mitch McConnell and his Super PACs are already raising millions from corporate special interests to try to make sure I don’t.
If there’s one thing I’ve learned in life, though, it’s that anything is possible when a group of people work together to make it happen. I’m not taking one dime from corporate PACs; instead, I’m running my campaign entirely with support from over 114,000 grassroots donors like you.
[**So please, if you’re able to, will you consider making a donation to my campaign today to help me defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue? Friend,

Do you know what it is like to be from a city owned by a country that you don't belong to? I do.

I grew up in Hong Kong, a city that was once free.

I was able to get involved in social movements at the age of 13. I was an international advocate and a student leader for Hong Kong.

Then, the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) imposed a national security law that cracked down on political activism in Hong Kong. Offenders could face penalties up to life in prison.

_Now, I am the first Hong Kong activist to receive political asylum in America_.

Let me introduce myself. My name is Frances Hui--former journalist, director of _We The Hongkongers_ , and speaker with the Dissident Project.

The Dissident Project provides high schools with access to informed, intelligent perspectives from speakers who have lived under current and former socialist states worldwide.

[_**Your support goes directly towards helping us teach students about the horrors of communism. Click here to help sponsor a speaker today >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ztts1l70482fdviskb1eo9l85vujvr83du9lfu98_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3g6cpr4cth2bs)

China is the 21st-century version of totalitarianism. They are the ultimate surveillance state. Your every action is evaluated by the government's social credit score.

The CCP's take over of Hong Kong has left no part of our lives untouched. They are turning Hong Kong into China.

_**Now, I am from a city owned by a country that I don 't belong to.**_

The Chinese Communist Party has done its best to silence any news of opposition. The once-thriving civil society in Hong Kong is completely demolished as the government criminalizes and interrogates dissidents and social workers.

They've even convinced corporations and international non-profits to turn a blind eye to their atrocities.

Worse, they sometimes collude with the CCP.

This is why the Dissident Project is so valuable. _This might be the only time high school students get to hear the truth_ about how life in Hong Kong has radically changed since being under the thumb of the CCP.

**I want to share my story with students across America. **

[_**Will you help me reach students with my story? Your gift of $3, $35, or even $100 helps me travel to high schools across the country. Please donate by clicking here >>>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmdpaqhlvdlal3036vvt5h4p1ovi4r70d4e0hkl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3g6cpr4cth2bs)

**Let me share how the Dissident Project works:**

Dissident Project speakers come from countries across the globe like Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea, and China.

We undergo a rigorous audition and training process. There we learn to communicate our experiences in a _powerful but compassionate_ way.

Topics like this can be tough for students to understand. That's why _we are specially trained to address students and have mastered the art of covering difficult and complex topics for young audiences. _

It costs roughly $1,000 to host a speaking event on a high school campus.

The Dissident Project is a not-for-profit endeavor. We don't charge schools for access to our speakers, so their testimonies are more accessible to all.

**But to keep our services completely free, we rely on the generosity of our donors. Will you chip in today and support the Dissident Project?**

They've even convinced corporations and international non-profits to turn a blind eye to their atrocities. Worse, they sometimes collude with the CCP. This is why the Dissident Project is so valuable. This might be the only time high school students get to hear the truth about how life in Hong Kong has radically changed since being under the thumb of the CCP. I want to share my story with students across America. Let me share how the Dissident Project works: Dissident Project speakers come from countries across the globe like Venezuela, Cuba, North Korea, and China. We undergo a rigorous audition and training process. There we learn to communicate our experiences in a powerful but compassionate way. Topics like this can be tough for students to understand. That's why we are specially trained to address students and have mastered the art of covering difficult and complex topics for young audiences. It costs roughly $1,000 to host a speaking event on a high school campus. The Dissident Project is a not-for-profit endeavor. We don't charge schools for access to our speakers, so their testimonies are more accessible to all. But to keep our services completely free, we rely on the generosity of our donors. Will you chip in today and support the Dissident Project? Peter,
I am an Air Force combat veteran who served in Afghanistan. I grew up in poverty in Puerto Rico, raised by a single mother who taught me patriotism, love of country, and hard work.
These days I'm a busy mom to two amazing kids myself. I built my medical logistics career after I got out of the Air Force, earning three degrees along the way (including a doctorate!) while working full time.
Only in America is a story like mine possible.
I am running in a newly drawn Republican +1 district here in Maryland against an incumbent that is Pelosi's closest ally in the House. We Can Win this District and Retake the HOUSE!
[My race in Maryland's 6th District is critical to the road to the Republican majority and sanity coming back to America.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001K-DCbhwEJFGxQVHF5OJfnPKgsKzMeUftpur1ocvIxo91mWRp6v2Iu11Tv6TlJJBhKHJO_Vg1y52fA6fXmRyNf6cECSNoKJOU4S0gXnkPPC2hWWFhdZK2Fh6FQOMrRrQOxPOMU3m0LwfhqW1HzYQCtP8azwsasbq-odS9qvNV0XWsUVw9gDtPUA==&c=yFwZcLMPb_JSyPZfmDtVa7AnQ3azb-o7rfM1sbyVBBvyUuchGalnFA==&ch=1ADzNxZvk7ihUwNzb0iPA6s3BvASeubey37-7KhfZ2YD_dqOw62BDQ==)

body:
Dear Reader, Please find a special message from our paid sponsor, Newsmax Media. Sponsorships like this help to allow us to continue to send you our service free of charge. We appreciate your support.
---
Dick Morris Has a 'Big Secret':
Trump Will Run Again . . . and Win! Dick's new bestseller reveals a surprising strategy that will thrill the MAGA world, shock the left-wing establishment . . . and win over millions of new Trump voters . . . [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64571%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ns7r4KwEYJArLt8JHyMrXQ&sysid=1)Donald Trump was angry . . . it was April 2020 and President Trump was behind more than 11 points in the polls -- and these were Republican polls! The left-wing media's years of attacks, manipulation, COVID -- and, well, outright lies about Trump -- were paying off big time for the Democrats. They were on the verge of taking the White House. Then President Trump sent out an urgent message: **"Call Dick Morris!"** Soon, Dick Morris became one of Trump's secret advisers -- part of his innermost "kitchen cabinet" -- with almost daily phone calls with the president and a flurry of memos and reports. Trump knew what he was getting with Dick Morris. He is one of the top political strategists in the world. He single-handedly nursed Bill Clinton from political oblivion to make an incredible political comeback in 1996. For that, _Time_ magazine dubbed Dick Morris "the most influential man in America." For decades now Dick has been at the forefront of advising presidents, prime ministers, world leaders, and now Donald Trump. In 2016, Dick Morris joined the Trump bandwagon for president early. He was so sure Trump would win, when all the pollsters said he'd lose, Dick wrote a book during the campaign. It was called "**Armageddon: How Trump Beats Hillary**." The big media laughed at Dick and the book. "Fiction," they called his book. Well, "**Armageddon** " was the only major pro-Trump book written in 2016. And it was a runaway bestseller -- sitting 13 weeks on the _New York Times_ bestseller list! Dick gave Trump a plan to win in 2016: Attack, confront, ridicule, and _destroy Hillary Clinton!_ The plan worked. Donald Trump became the president of the United States. In his blockbuster NEW book, **The Return: Trump's Big 2024 Comeback** , Dick Morris once again reveals how Donald Trump can soon become the 47th president of the United States. But in **The Return** , Dick reveals _3 Principles_ for patriotic Americans who want to win in 2024:
* First, make sure the upcoming elections are free and fair - we can't let it happen again!
* Second, our candidate _must_ be Donald J. Trump -- no exceptions
* Third, we must win back the country by reframing the Trump agenda to create the New Majority

Since he left office, Donald Trump and Dick Morris speak all the time. For the first time, Dick goes public with what really happened in 2020 . . . and what he and Trump know must happen now for "the return" to happen in 2024.******** BIG IDEA #1: Conservatives must realize that there are new rules. | President Trump Says: "Dick Morris and I conferred regularly throughout the 2016 and 2020 campaigns. He helped me hone my message and aim it at the right audience. His father was my attorney, and he is my counselor."
---
Unless the right figures out how to beat the Democrats and the radical left under these new rules, freedom-loving Americans will lose again.
You've seen the massive repercussions of a 2020 election where the bad guys won by making their own rules.
As a result we face crushing inflation, unfathomable gas prices, a devalued dollar, wide-open borders, raging crime, and major wars breaking out -- just for starters.
_President Biden?_

Hi team

We want to make sure that you saw this note from Ann – it has been a whole year since we launched and we are so proud of how far Team Roe has come in this last year.

So much has been accomplished and we don't think Ann is bragging enough about how far we've come together:
* We raised over **$325,000** in the last year.
* We collected over **2,000 signatures** across every county in the district so that Ann would appear on the ballot.
* We've gone to nearly **50 events, fundraisers, and meet and greets** around the district and neighboring areas.

That's why Mitch McConnell and Republican dark-money special interests are ramping up their spending to distract voters from their own abysmal candidates by attacking Democrats like John Fetterman, Raphael Warnock, Maggie Hassan, and Mark Kelly. Peter,
I am re-sending this email because the original version accidentally had an erroneous link.
I am an Air Force combat veteran who served in Afghanistan. I grew up in poverty in Puerto Rico, raised by a single mother who taught me patriotism, love of country, and hard work.
These days I'm a busy mom to two amazing kids myself. I built my medical logistics career after I got out of the Air Force, earning three degrees along the way (including a doctorate!) while working full time.
Only in America is a story like mine possible.
I am running in a newly drawn Republican +1 district here in Maryland against an incumbent that is Pelosi's closest ally in the House. We Can Win this District and Retake the HOUSE!

name: John Lira
subject: America is the land of abundance — immigration policy should reflect that
body:
Our district is the epicenter of our nation’s outdated asylum laws and our broken legal immigration system. | Peter, there is no other district in the country that includes more of the U.S.-Mexico border than TX-23. Our district is the epicenter of our nation’s outdated asylum laws and our broken legal immigration system. Our community sees by far the most encounters between migrants and law enforcement of any other district. So when I heard that more than 50 migrants had lost their lives just outside of San Antonio, I knew that without active immigration reform, it would only be a matter of time before the next devastating tragedy. [**Peter, this is exactly why I am running for Congress. Lives are on the line and we must enact bipartisan, humane immigration reforms that will protect the lives of immigrants AND our communities. If you agree, will you chip in to help fund my campaign?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820275/355788050/1997388722?refcode=em20220714&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=) **[CHIP IN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820276/355788051/1997388722?refcode=em20220714&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=)** I firmly believe that the United States must remain the land of opportunity for all, including immigrants, who add tremendous value to our nation. Migrants can play a vital part in the revival of our economy, especially on the hundreds of ranches, farms and factories in West Texas. But I believe just as firmly that to represent the people of Texas, I must be willing to engage with all points of view. That’s why I have been traveling extensively to border communities and talking with people who are concerned about immigration in their communities. I share their concerns about our overburdened system and the need to allocate federal and local resources equitably. **The narrative that pits border residents against migrant workers creates a false choice. America is the land of abundance, and there is enough economic opportunity for everyone.** There’s a future where we protect our border communities and treat immigrants with dignity and respect. Together, we can work towards that future and prevent senseless deaths like those in San Antonio. [**Can you make a donation to help me get to Washington and fight for bold, meaningful, bipartisan border legislation that treats immigrants and border communities with respect?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820277/355788052/1997388722?refcode=em20220714&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=) In gratitude and solidarity, John Lira **[DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820278/355788053/1997388722?refcode=em20220714&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=)** | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820279/355788054/-593876365?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=&emci=a8ae10a5-9103-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=b6ae10a5-9103-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820280/355788055/-1869672870?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiNmFlMTBhNS05MTAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=61yYkblHaMOx3DuzDgKZHJqTakXXP96GgXzSK718eG4=&emci=a8ae10a5-9103-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=b6ae10a5-9103-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=25686212)

|
# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820360/355788713/-707005773?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWUxZjMzMi05MjAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UBAkFSypHhj1riWZF6BozGP_w2qMLz1FEXWACa_GCPA=)
Friend,

Thank you to everyone who worked so hard to achieve Will’s success in the Primary, and secure his place on the November ballot!

Exciting Updates: \+ The last update from Riverside County Registrar of Voters shows that there are more registered Democrats than Republicans in this district for the first time in 30 years!
\+ The last time Ken Calvert had a competitive election was in 2008 and he only won by 1.8% in a much redder district.
\+ We just crossed $1.4 million raised and have now had three record breaking fundraising quarters. You: \+ Wrote & distributed more than 10,000 postcards
\+ Made thousands of phone calls
\+ Knocked on doors throughout the District
\+ Shared campaign messages countless times on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram; through letters to newspapers; and through personal conversations You helped the campaign achieve record-breaking fundraising numbers, outpacing every Democrat who’s ever challenged Ken Calvert! With those donations, the campaign: \+ Sent mailers to voters throughout the entire district
\+ Aired TV ads
\+ Delivered digital ads to thousands of voters
\+ Supported the campaign infrastructure, including technology, a campaign office, and small staff Will’s message was shared throughout the district and across the nation through: \+ Appearances on KESQ and NBC Palm Springs; as well as multiple articles in The Desert Sun; and the Press-Enterprise
\+ Articles in The New York Times; San Francisco Chronicle; LA Times; Bloomberg; Washington Post; and appearances on several podcasts
\+ Nearly 800 social media posts, across Twitter, Instagram and Facebook. For comparison, incumbent Ken Calvert posted 112 times. Will met with voters directly at: \+ Multiple rallies supporting abortion rights
\+ Multiple rallies opposing gun violence
\+ Meet & greets and fundraisers
\+ Regular appearances at Democratic club meetings throughout the District
\+ Canvassing Primary Results: \+ We held Calvert to under 50%
\+ Turnout was nearly even for Democrat and Republican voters What Team Rollins is doing now: \+ After taking a short breather, we are focused on growing the team through the end of July.
\+ In August we will hit the ground running with our grassroots field program and talk to voters in every corner of the district. **_How you can help now:_** \+ **[Sign up](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47820361/355788714/-1832136438?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzcxMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYWUxZjMzMi05MjAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UBAkFSypHhj1riWZF6BozGP_w2qMLz1FEXWACa_GCPA=&emci=1cda1eac-8703-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=bae1f332-9203-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=12636851)** to volunteer for future voter outreach events. Thelander Blasts Ruling of U.S. Court of Appeals in Boston Upholding Ban on Lobster Fishing Across 1,000 Mile Zone in Maine Waters | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/thelanderforcongress/thelander-blasts-court-ruling-that-threatens-to-crush-maine-lobster-industry?e=f8a0a76a2b)

# Thelander Blasts Court Ruling that Threatens to Crush Maine Lobster Industry
Ed Thelander blasted the ruling by the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 1st Circuit in Boston upholding a ban on lobster fishing across a nearly 1,000 mile zone in Maine waters. Thelander asks his opponent, Democratic Congresswoman Chellie Pingree, why the 1st Congressional District representative hasn’t been fighting harder for Maine lobstermen and women.

“The ban just doesn’t make sense,” Thelander, a retired Navy SEAL, stressed. “Right whales aren’t migrating through those waters, and it is well past time for the regulators and the courts to catch up with the actual science. The lobster industry is part of our heritage, and they need someone in Washington who’s got their backs.”

Thelander spent the Fourth of July weekend swimming between lobster boats gathered off Chebeague Island in Casco Bay, climbing on board from boat to boat and talking with lobstermen about the many challenges they face right now, including the drop in wholesale prices driven by runaway inflation.

“This ruling is yet another bump in a long road. My opponent is routinely backed by groups that push the regulations currently strangling the lobster industry. The regulators down in Washington need to hear one thing: if they continue strangling Maine businesses, we’re going to re-write the law and set what’s wrong right.”Eighth-generation Swan’s Island lobsterman Jason Joyce weighed in, “The National Marine Fisheries Service’s own data reveals Right whales don't traverse that area. Additionally, the 1000 square miles the closed area is suspiciously close to an area sought as an offshore wind lease site by multinational corporations and state and federal proponents of offshore wind projects. The last 2 years have brought higher fuel and bait costs coupled with the negative effects of 40-year high inflation. Maine's 5000 lobster fishing families who are dependent on commercial fishing to keep our communities alive want to send a clear message to those seeking to replace our lobster industry with destructive offshore wind turbines: We will fight for our heritage, defend the environment, and oppose all efforts to industrialize the Gulf of Maine. I can think of no better person to deliver this message to D.C. than veteran Navy SEAL Ed Thelander. If Mainers truly want to end bad policies that hurt our small businesses, we can't elect representatives that defend those bad policies, year after year.”Thelander recently published an article in The Maine Wire [discussing the challenges facing the lobster industry](https://thelanderforcongress.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=035bf0620f01206429344ca39&id=ac28b0309c&e=f8a0a76a2b).

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. body:
I am the only Democrat in this race with clear-cut goals and plans to create a safer, more prosperous Los Angeles.

Friend,

During this campaign, I’ve had the privilege to speak with Angelenos from all walks of life. No matter who I talk to, I hear similar sentiments again and again: we love this city and will do anything to create a bright future for the coming generations.

Team, Los Angeles has called me home, and I am ready to serve. And the fact is, I am the _only_ Democrat in this race with clear-cut goals and plans to create a safer, more prosperous Los Angeles.

As mayor, I will lead the city’s efforts to address our homelessness and affordable housing crises with urgency, compassion, and care. We will work to improve public safety by expanding job programs and social services. We'll prioritize climate justice so we can ensure clean air and water — especially in communities suffering most from pollution — reduce the cost of energy bills, and create new jobs.

My competitor has made some lofty promises but failed to detail his plans to make them happen. At the same time, he's already invested over $40 million of his own money into his campaign, which is likely to double by November.

**Money can buy many things,_but it can’t buy a vision._**

We can win this race in November. We can make history. Tomorrow at midnight, my campaign is facing a mid-month deadline, and I'm counting on your support.

Does this worry me, friend? _Absolutely._ I just ran my FIRST TV ad of the election cycle to counter Marco Rubio's lies about my law enforcement service. The TV ads cost me an arm and a leg – but it was a necessary risk if we want to flip Florida blue. I never anticipated donations to plummet over the past few days, when this team has had my back _from day one_.

That’s why at one of his previous rallies here, he said: “Taking America back begins with kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.” And the truth is, if we don’t have the resources we need to win this race, he might get his wish. Millions of dollars have already been spent trying to defeat us, and millions more are coming. If Trump can help flip this seat, he’ll be that much more likely to run in 2024. He might even win. Sorry to put that thought in your head, but it’s true. That’s why I need to know if you can make a contribution before Trump arrives. Because when he does, a lot of people from the far right are going to start looking at this race. And after that, those same folks are going to start pouring money into Arizona to try to beat me. So, I’m humbly asking: = It is absolutely critical that we hold this seat. And the only way that happens is if we’re all in this together. Mark Kelly **= Paid for by Friends of Dick Durbin

body:
| | Friend, **Tomorrow, the House of Representatives is set to vote on two bills that will directly help our fight for abortion rights: The Women’s Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act. ** Both of these bills — **fought for and introduced by House Democrats** — give our representatives the chance to push back against the recent conservative-led Supreme Court ruling to overturn our constitutional right to abortion. We’ve already seen what this ruling has done across the country — over 36 million Americans have been thrown into constitutional, legal, and health care chaos, specifically people of color, who already face the brunt of anti-choice, draconian laws. With the health and safety of millions of Americans on the line, **there has never been a more crucial time for our representatives to act.** [Take action: Write your representative now to ensure they pass this necessary legislation to protect our bodily autonomy and our futures.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47832522/355814933/382066726?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Y3NzVkZi1hMDAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eowUDI7enxw34Ps6V_q8OtlzRZJv-3hdY8eVaNVbClc=&emci=fd9c0ae4-7a03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2cf775df-a003-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) Here’s how both bills will protect our right to abortion and push back against the recent ruling from the Supreme Court. **The Ensuring Access to Abortion Act codifies the right to travel out of state for abortion care into law, and seeks to help those who do travel for the care. ** The Women’s Health Protection Act protects our right to abortion nationwide through:
* **Upholding the right to access abortion throughout the United States;**
* **Protecting against bans and medically unnecessary restrictions on abortion, including mandatory waiting periods, biased counseling, and two-trip requirements;**
* **Establishing a statutory right for health care professionals to provide abortion care to their patients.**

These two pieces of legislation will be life-saving. By passing this legislation, our representatives will put us back on a path of progress, despite what the Supreme Court has ruled and the schemes of Republican lawmakers. Now, more than ever, we need our representatives to fight for our right to abortion. [Write your representative and urge them to pass both the Women’s Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47832524/355814936/-1042395962?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Y3NzVkZi1hMDAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eowUDI7enxw34Ps6V_q8OtlzRZJv-3hdY8eVaNVbClc=&emci=fd9c0ae4-7a03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2cf775df-a003-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172) | [Send a message](https://click.everyaction.com/k/47832525/355814938/1686487393?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyY2Y3NzVkZi1hMDAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=eowUDI7enxw34Ps6V_q8OtlzRZJv-3hdY8eVaNVbClc=&emci=fd9c0ae4-7a03-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=2cf775df-a003-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=6787172 "CTA Button")

clean_body: | | Friend, Tomorrow, the House of Representatives is set to vote on two bills that will directly help our fight for abortion rights: The Women’s Health Protection Act and the Ensuring Access to Abortion Act. Both of these bills — fought for and introduced by House Democrats — give our representatives the chance to push back against the recent conservative-led Supreme Court ruling to overturn our constitutional right to abortion. We’ve already seen what this ruling has done across the country — over 36 million Americans have been thrown into constitutional, legal, and health care chaos, specifically people of color, who already face the brunt of anti-choice, draconian laws. With the health and safety of millions of Americans on the line, there has never been a more crucial time for our representatives to act. Here’s how both bills will protect our right to abortion and push back against the recent ruling from the Supreme Court. The Ensuring Access to Abortion Act codifies the right to travel out of state for abortion care into law, and seeks to help those who do travel for the care. The Women’s Health Protection Act protects our right to abortion nationwide through: Upholding the right to access abortion throughout the United States; Protecting against bans and medically unnecessary restrictions on abortion, including mandatory waiting periods, biased counseling, and two-trip requirements; Establishing a statutory right for health care professionals to provide abortion care to their patients. These two pieces of legislation will be life-saving. By passing this legislation, our representatives will put us back on a path of progress, despite what the Supreme Court has ruled and the schemes of Republican lawmakers. Now, more than ever, we need our representatives to fight for our right to abortion. | "CTA Button" Let’s get this done, NextGen America | NextGen America** 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

#

Friends -
For too long, the ATF operated in lockstep with the firearm industry.
So with the confirmation of Steve Dettelbach, it’s worth taking a moment to share what is now possible when a Director of the ATF prioritizes public safety.
So what can the new director do?
✅ Combat gun trafficking
✅ Shut down bad actor dealers
✅ Enforce the ghost gun rule
✅ Modernize the gun tracing process
✅ Keep up to date with new technologies
✅ Hold the gun industry accountable.
That’s why the NRA REALLY didn’t want a new ATF Director.
And it’s why we fought so hard to help get one confirmed.
Thank you for your role in that fight. It was absolutely critical.
We did it.
Now you know why.
The team at Giffords

Marijuana doesn’t pose significant harm to those who consume it, and far too many Americans are locked up for possession or sale of Marijuana. **** Perhaps more importantly, we also must release and expunge the records of all people convicted for cannabis possession. The war on drugs was a horrific mistake by our government. Many Americans, including a disproportionate number of minorities, were imprisoned for years because they committed the victimless “crime” of selling or using cannabis. **** Here’s my plan: when I’m in Congress, I will re-introduce legislation for total federal legalization of cannabis and expungement of criminal records for cannabis consumption. clean_body: | | Friend, It’s past time for America to legalize weed. ** A vast majority of the country agrees that Americans should be able to freely use and grow cannabis for medicinal and recreational use. But our politicians refuse to enact the will of the people. We have to legalize consumption and growing of all parts of the cannabis plant. Marijuana doesn’t pose significant harm to those who consume it, and far too many Americans are locked up for possession or sale of Marijuana. Perhaps more importantly, we also must release and expunge the records of all people convicted for cannabis possession. The war on drugs was a horrific mistake by our government. Many Americans, including a disproportionate number of minorities, were imprisoned for years because they committed the victimless “crime” of selling or using cannabis. ** Here’s my plan: when I’m in Congress, I will re-introduce legislation for total federal legalization of cannabis and expungement of criminal records for cannabis consumption. Americans of all political parties support legalizing cannabis, and I’m confident that politicians who oppose this legislation will face significant blowback at home. body:

body:
I am passionate about protecting our environment. Learn about my priority issues. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/d02272d582e2/our-environment-needs-protection-im-ready-for-the-challenge?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| | |
---
| | |
# Hello Peter,
**P****rotecting the environment is of vital importance to me**. I realize the threats to our environment are abundant and imminent. There is a tremendous amount of work to be done to protect our natural resources at a local, state, and national level.

As your Congresswoman, **I will rely upon experts to inform my policy priorities, and I will fight for immediate action in our district**.

My legal background and decades of advocacy experience will help me drive local initiatives and education and navigate the environmental policy that needs to be implemented at all levels to help support and bolster local efforts.
---
| | **Let me Tell You a Story. . .**

Lawyers and advocates often have to quickly become experts in a field they initially know little about. In August of 2018, I spent time with the [Dilley Project](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=732cc8a30c&e=9c22e4067b) representing immigrant mothers and their children being held in a detention center near the border in Dilley, Texas, during their show cause hearings for asylum.

An unforeseen issue we encountered was that _as a visitor_ we were informed that the **drinking water was contaminated with heavy metals due to nearby fracking.** As visiting attorneys, we were allowed to bring our own bottled water with us each day into the extreme heat of the desert. However, we were warned by Core Civic, the private company running the detention facility, that if we were caught sharing our clean, bottled water with any of the detainees or their children, we would have our credentials permanently revoked.

**Not only did I have to immediately come up to speed on asylum law, which I had never previously practiced, but also with aspects of fracking, water pollution and prisoners’ rights** in order to file an injunction against Core Civic to force them to provide clean water to their detainees.
---
|
---
| | | **We have big environmental battles to tackle, and I am ready to** **[fight](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=e3d047bbdf&e=9c22e4067b)**. Here are the [environmental priorities](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=b16d5046dc&e=9c22e4067b) that I will champion if elected.
* **Reining in Unfettered Development:** Uncontrolled development is a major issue because of its impact on the environment. Building codes in many counties have not been updated to account for naturally changing landscapes and outdated infrastructure. Rapid development practices lead to excess run-off of water occurring as a result of frequent major rain events or extreme storms. While controlled, responsible development is necessary to continue to bolster our economy, unfettered development needs to be reined in with legislation, infrastructure planning and a commitment to leverage sustainable, environmentally-friendly options for growth.

* **Halting Environmental Injustice & Racism: **Superfund sites and landfills with borrow pits such as those found in the Wedgewood and Rolling Hills neighborhoods of Pensacola have become a problematic legacy of flooding and contamination, which present a severe health risk for many residents–many of whom have already died due to this legacy. Left unregulated, these contaminated pits will continue seeping into the aquifer causing harm to families who live nearby. We need to ensure that the needs of the impacted communities are a priority for the state agencies involved and that our communities - especially those of color – are no longer targeted and harmed by these practices.

* **Protecting Our Natural Resources:** The lifeblood of the Panhandle is our natural resources. From the beaches to the farmland, these resources provide tourism, recreation, and economic vibrancy. We must protect our coast from threats both immediate and long-term. Climate change is real and it is impacting our community. If predicted rises in sea level and temperature prove to be accurate, by the year 2050, our coast will experience a 2-to-10 foot rise in sea level. This type of catastrophic change would render our beaches and coastal towns no longer viable places to live. The seasonal crops, timber, livestock and fishing industries that we rely upon will be permanently harmed. It is time to put legislation in place that will help ward off further erosion of our coveted natural resources and help our coastal communities thrive.

---
| My experience in Texas is one of many that has helped me do **what I do best - identify problems, become an expert quickly, and take action to protect those in need.**

**Our environment needs protecting.**

I'd be honored if you'd **vote for me, Peggy Schiller, in the primary on 8/23 and again on 11/8**, so that I can represent you and our coveted environment in Washington.

Peter, today was surreal. I just cast my ballot for John and myself at the Baltimore County Board of Elections. It’s hard to explain just how humbling and profound it was to not only see my name on the ballot, but to experience this moment with my mom by my side... truly an incredible feeling I will never forget. After my family left our home in Iran in the wake of the Iranian revolution, my mother taught me how important it was to never take any of our rights for granted. It was she who instilled in me the radical idea that my value should never be limited by my gender. It is because of her and my own experiences that I’ve dedicated my career towards achieving equal rights for women here in Maryland and nationally. **Now, as a mom myself, I am grateful for the opportunity to show my kids that anything is possible — and to bring my mom along to watch me do something she never could have imagined: continue the fight for equal rights on an even bigger scale as a part of this ticket with John. ** clean_body: I am eternally grateful for all the work that our team, volunteers, and grassroots supporters like you have put into this campaign. | = Peter, today was surreal. I just cast my ballot for John and myself at the Baltimore County Board of Elections. It’s hard to explain just how humbling and profound it was to not only see my name on the ballot, but to experience this moment with my mom by my side... truly an incredible feeling I will never forget. After my family left our home in Iran in the wake of the Iranian revolution, my mother taught me how important it was to never take any of our rights for granted. It was she who instilled in me the radical idea that my value should never be limited by my gender. It is because of her and my own experiences that I’ve dedicated my career towards achieving equal rights for women here in Maryland and nationally. Now, as a mom myself, I am grateful for the opportunity to show my kids that anything is possible — and to bring my mom along to watch me do something she never could have imagined: continue the fight for equal rights on an even bigger scale as a part of this ticket with John. = I am eternally grateful for all the work that our team, volunteers, and grassroots supporters like you have put into this campaign. All that John and I have been able to accomplish thus far has been thanks to you all, but early vote turnout has been at record lows and we need your help to motivate voters to get to the polls on Tuesday! = John, the team, and I will be knocking on doors all weekend, and we would really appreciate some last-minute grassroots support to recruit more volunteers and reach even more undecided voters over the airwaves. = Thank you again for your support, Michelle Siri * | | = Paid for by John King for Governor, Eliza Leighton, Treasurer John King for Governor PO Box 8429 Silver Spring, MD 20907 United States | | | ---|---|--- | = = If you would like to learn more about John King's historic campaign for Maryland governor, text PROGRESS to 48178 or visit our _. Team, we’re frustrated by how many Democratic campaigns, organizations, and activists **waste time and money on things that don’t work.**
As more and more candidates and organizations ask for your donations, it's easy for them to simply say, “We elected these great candidates!" and leave out whether their work actually had a provable, measurable impact.

body:
The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6250%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=QdDyeWiw4d9hWpCJyr8vIw&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64587%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vWtZcZksnMQsP3d0%2bEM7vg&sysid=1) Dear Friend of the Constitution, The far Left in America is attempting to rewrite our nation’s history and undermine our Constitution--with a special emphasis on eliminating the Second Amendment. Today, you’re receiving Hillsdale College’s **Second Amendment Survey** because you’re someone who understands that education is essential to the defense of liberty. We are reaching and teaching millions of Americans about the importance of liberty, and we are doing this without accepting even ONE PENNY of government funding. Could you take a few minutes to complete our **Second Amendment Survey** using the secure link below? **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64588%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sQ3YUFQ1M8BlcAgBQ8nVNQ&sysid=1 "https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/")** Your timely survey answers will help us reach and teach millions of our fellow citizens in the coming year about the importance of liberty--which includes the rights protected by the Second Amendment. There is no question that one of the Left’s most powerful tools in its ongoing effort to undermine our liberty is **ignorance**. Here at Hillsdale, we have been pursuing truth and defending liberty since the College was founded in 1844. Today our educational outreach efforts include programs on a variety of topics essential to liberty, such as the Second Amendment. As constitutional scholar Edward J. Erler observed in _Imprimis_ , our digest of liberty that reaches millions of Americans: “The Second Amendment is an expression of **first principles**.” This means the Second Amendment is essential for the preservation of freedom. If we are denied the means of defending our freedom, we will eventually lose our freedom. This kind of thinking is foreign to most college and university campuses today, where “safe spaces” are now commonplace, and shooting clubs are nearly extinct. Here’s an example... Not long ago, the University of Virginia canceled its traditional 21-gun salute on Veterans Day. Why? The administration was concerned that firing guns in honor of those who served their country and did their part to defend our freedom would cause “panic” among the student body. Unfortunately, there are many more such examples I could cite to illustrate the disastrous effects of the ongoing decline in civics education in America. **But instead of just TALKING, it’s more important to DO something about it.** That’s why we have been working to expand our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. And this work continues today. That’s why I would like your answers to our brief **Second Amendment Survey.** You can complete the survey today at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64588%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sQ3YUFQ1M8BlcAgBQ8nVNQ&sysid=1)** We believe that an educated citizenry is essential for the preservation of our liberty. As Ronald Reagan said, “Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction.” Do you agree? I hope so. This is why we **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans about the principles of liberty and the Constitution. It’s also why we need your help today. As I mentioned, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. Our independence from the government means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of citizens like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. It also means your gift really matters. **Today, you have a great opportunity to help preserve liberty --including the Second Amendment--for future generations.** After completing your **Second Amendment Survey** , please join me in the cause of liberty with your generous tax-deductible gift today. And, when you give a $100 gift or more, we’ll send you a special, limited-edition Hillsdale College hat as our thank you. This hat commemorates our partnership with USA Shooting, the organization dedicated to preparing the best American shooters to represent our country in the Olympics and Paralympics. But hurry--supplies are limited! Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed **Second Amendment Survey.** Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
**P.S.** Our Constitution--including the Second Amendment--is under attack today. Do you agree? Then please take our **Second Amendment Survey** at the secure link below. It will only take a few minutes, and your answers will help to preserve liberty for future generations. Thank you! **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/2a-survey/](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c64588%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=sQ3YUFQ1M8BlcAgBQ8nVNQ&sysid=1)**
---

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek, can I give

supporters who power
this campaign is to hear your stories. Because
Derek, my name
may be on the ballot — but this campaign is not about me. It’s about you —
your story, your family’s story and the stories of millions of Georgians
across the state who Brian Kemp has left behind.

Together, we can open gates of opportunity across Georgia and make it a
place where all can thrive, regardless of background or zip code.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1499?refcode=sa_em_220714_B1_Calls_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=971%2E1862389%2EnWoZWT ]Can you chip in $5, or whatever makes sense for your
budget today? Any amount — no matter how big or small — might give us a
chance to talk over the phone. I would love the chance to call and thank
you very soon.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1499?refcode=sa_em_220714_B1_Calls_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=971%2E1862389%2EnWoZWT ]DONATE

families and your communities. It is easy to feel helpless — but it is
vital to remember that we are not alone. In this moment of crisis, in this
moment of pain, we've got to take care of one another. To believe in our
ability to protect one another. To lean into our capacity to defend our
rights in the streets and at the ballot box.

Our work — to fire a dangerous, extremist governor and begin building One
Georgia — is not easy. So I want to thank grassroots
supporters like you
personally for digging deep and doing the critical work to ensure we win
in November and can begin delivering for Georgians.
Derek, I am
proud to count you as a grassroots
supporter and that is
why I will be looking for your name on my call list.

Derek, whether
you have supported me since 2018 or joined us just last week, I want to
have the chance to say thank you, directly, for all that you do for my
campaign and in your communities.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1499?refcode=sa_em_220714_B1_Calls_S1_T1_SYA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=971%2E1862389%2EnWoZWT ]I’d love the chance to speak with you personally,
Derek. Can you make your
first
$5 donation right now? Anything you can give will make a
real difference — and you could end up on my call list soon.

Let’s get it done,

Stacey

[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdfchkv6fnfiqfa7j53avpbtqqgs0uha4nj5abco_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbpjct3kshh68pbgs2q68ojl6lrm2pb0s4pm0t3kcupneoj5mhpr0slgc4p6ecbgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6tj3co5jcgrr5d366pgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933cljm1oj5c9gm1oh5u)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zfdmp4gd6ra6vokkq5rsc1ef9uesces4udkrmmhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2za9csab0gi68n23sp3c9fhhi6ssmbr772llask8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu3jfli0csanhtm8gp01o1pcdrj917ejkbmsq15o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zipija96v7ofj44ui354bcjq1g8emhqddmv0ij1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2ztsasroucemnq5bsqr9uilaheckrnhu7oo7qctc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdh70r8n7dhm676upejmck2ld1n3nud1foelho08_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcbj9il5ksgms95rcpe7h5fl5lhi2reju3j28re8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2gfu7653lsmd9p7s3bm88ou75p7dr4nvej4pcig_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zonru24f5qk6e6mt9adltohg42h9c4kgclg3rgi0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgo7e2hukvrtchp6icihdn0f7hn59ck3s2avb3kg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zm0vrvpd76ca32l5p5cmt3q4eo7u0c866gu7k7po_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zcri37mlicngio27p0dvb8ajf745cgsafvnvs5lg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zr6n9hd4q1srok4el57e8kkrmugih1ud9lghs2t0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvjb92scln8qfnpusntsm58g6cn8pr19bprv9740_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zi4lb3kb41tgh9u9gjbeskm8ahv1up4rj5bk50vg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zg396ke1sjq0tfin2cr77d8r8rc010u1b0d1ajl0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6aoj1c3h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation
