Peter, My opponent Max Miller can’t run on his record of being President Trump’s lackey, so he’s taken advantage of high gas prices to claim that Democrats are failing the American people. **** During a rare public appearance, Max [called for Joe Biden to “open up our pipelines”](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/dSCQfi9FLISmU3ZE3bfPhj8fclZg3vKtVXXB4VrcfFEb77lkL31i2VhnV2tzghCXIjoJx_MrpP0phZ4sKni6m1AZ92VHrGTCZiUAaBHDnEoZWWDYbYU30zl0pqCPpB9mgpeuu-9fOtWUu6Fiegh1j5-mo939vV3z1LSYhA-e384zIIdDxrtg0T4-6q4Bh8eeLIYcMdTpidJhfnhZU0tkxVC66ZLp7PaVxINd8gTayfDy-n4n83jm2idepnVm5-UzpMK2BKdYuwkan6U_P2lD_lOW-npRFysckXMRjPEbUq62jtFFASkvcBwcHt3Yb4w46QCKo7e2ZcTV48sZ15KNDw/3nq/GiDqqnjMRcGENmI838nB8g/h0/NgtQVcOlbFe9mcSHH48hnxjeDs5VVEkPv8P2srI1pww) while standing in front of a gas station. But he didn’t even explain which pipelines aren’t open and how he would help lower gas prices. Make no mistake, high gas prices are a major problem that create hardship for hardworking Ohioans. But instead of proposing policies that help Ohioans by supporting working families and diversifying our energy sources, Max Miller is nonsensically criticizing. Max can't propose real solutions to bring down gas prices for the middle class because he has no idea what it's like to actually struggle to pay for fuel. He grew up as a member of [Cleveland's "Royalty](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDC9UQvmW4cfKy2v4PE3Ci3vTsKpydKYRhWrFbx1PbvzWEFQqoCJ8DagmTKSJRTguSSE6DeFiF05StD1IG_Qz8DtDsIisMFK1bNPVAH3vxRsMWaKMVBbs8XR_uqLMgXWR078UX2LWNzndkDSzhwauTjuksZV0T4JM3ktKtLooQFvXbL7GYUIr2Wpioy0FQ-IYdsmJKi5RZP5n4PTewlxtmxSLmIpoIIDO1PiLif9I5cciifbsIs38tAv1vJYMbcOdTtp_DEv3yyfe8BxRjTyoMDiCZ-cBddI1zwEWhDDF6T_2QJca1quSvGfAfmBiQADnF6zPCCeKmAQ0Az2XpGg6eyMmryfEbTNHp3VeJHrTyCCc7477_ZEwdv8HaHESfnoyQgIl3A7fDkRxf_IJR6PwYq6LfO-qIBuz6dPdorjMZUVY/3nq/GiDqqnjMRcGENmI838nB8g/h1/AsPA97SkQCpL6UVMRCj0LxMtitgFV0Mnszt_O_R1HqI)["](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDC9UQvmW4cfKy2v4PE3Ci3vTsKpydKYRhWrFbx1PbvzWEFQqoCJ8DagmTKSJRTguSSE6DeFiF05StD1IG_Qz8DtDsIisMFK1bNPVAH3vxRsMWaKMVBbs8XR_)[](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDC9UQvmW4cfKy2v4PE3Ci3vTsKpydKYRhWrFbx1PbvzWEFQqoCJ8DagmTKSJRTguSSE6DeFiF05StD1IG_Qz8DtDsIisMFK1bNPVAH3vxRsMWaKMVBbs8XR_uqLMgXWR078UX2LWNzndkDSzhwauTjuksZV0T4JM3ktKtLooQFvXe9liAesfehOsG7R5MLW1FvA4QE6lST9B_TIubad5_KVby6rkNALsMmB6rezDLpyf8AoDNMI-TD76xcMGSTPhXOsC13cIZberjCkUaGE5BnongnFD9PqfQMWEUpg6Jrz8ZUQt2-GdAIXXGqlgjoKZ0Qvij48jiwPngv5B7l5LXGXQ-xzBUDhiK9ify7GHN-6qeEtD-bXAyGdIYsCf1z2vv2AbdyHMkPEicIMgFMtlac6V-A-vUMnc9mJ4dkJ9ShbK/3nq/GiDqqnjMRcGENmI838nB8g/h3/x2cXjk4noh31uU-S84N_evLTOdtMjMexaQd5vR6Hs-I), and was able to take affording living expenses for granted.
When I was growing up, my dad biked to work every day because our family could only afford to pay for one car. Deb and I both understand that the choice to become a parent is both personal and life-changing, Deb will work to restore the right to legal, accessible reproductive care in Congress. Her opponent would aid the GOP’s attempts to ban abortion nationwide. She’ll also stand up for LGBTQ+ Wisconsinites, like our son, who are under attack from the far right.

2. Deb’s career in the U.S. Army and the CIA took her around the globe, and she saw what happens when democracy is threatened elsewhere. She knows that America’s democracy is now under threat from within, and her commitment to defending it is ironclad. Unlike her opponent, Deb knows the will of the people is sacred and elections must be respected. She will hold those who seek to undermine our democratic process accountable for their actions.

3. Deb has proved again and again that she will honor her oath to protect and defend the Constitution at every turn. She goes the extra mile - like taking on Airborne training, and earning her Master’s degree from the U.S. Army War College - because our country deserves nothing less. When we were attacked on 9/11, Deb joined the CIA because she knew she had to step up again. Meanwhile, her opponent, Derrick Van Orden, dishonored his military oath by participating in the January 6th insurrection.

4. Deb is ready to “jump in,” no matter the challenge. Running for Congress isn’t easy, but Deb believes that Wisconsinites deserve the best possible representation in Washington. Our communities, small businesses, family farms, and working families are worth it. She even turned back the clock to her Army Airborne training and recently jumped out of a plane to prove her readiness and commitment to serve WI-03.

5. The GOP would need to flip just 5 blue districts - like ours - to retake control of the House and imperil any progress our Democratic majorities could make. The path to holding the Democratic majority _must_ include WI-03. If we want to continue making progress on the issues that matter most, we must ensure Democrats succeed in November.

In response, Schmitt's campaign devolved into a meltdown level of attacks against his biggest opponent in the GOP primary and refused to say whether he regrets working with Chappelle-Nadal to champion big bipartisan deals that Democrats like and conservatives do not. Chappelle-Nadal sent out a tweet in January with a photograph showing her and Schmitt smiling side by side. The caption she put on the photograph reads: "7 years ago today. We are still moving mountains." Mariana Deal, Attorney General Schmitt's Director of Communications, liked the tweet, which came years after Chappelle-Nadal called for Trump's assassination in 2017. The early 2022 tweet is not publicly visible at this time as Chappelle-Nadal's tweets are protected. It is unclear when the Twitter account went private, and if it was public at one point this year or not-but the date of the tweet is just weeks before Schmitt hosted a fundraiser at Trump's luxurious seaside Palm Beach resort Mar-a-Lago in early 2022. The shocking photograph and caption raise concerns around Schmitt's ties to the far left and exactly what "mountains" the pair have moved together. After refusing to resign, she continued her radical streak. For instance, Chappelle-Nadal in 2018 demanded during a debate over a tax bill that the state legislature create a reparations policy for black Missourians due to slavery and asserted that then-Sen. Claire McCaskill (D-MO) was "no different" than Republicans. "Neither one of them give a heck about the black community, only the votes," Chappelle-Nadal said on the floor of the Senate. Breitbart News reached out to Chappelle-Nadal on Wednesday regarding the social media post. In response, she spoke glowingly of Schmitt-praising their working relationship and discussing several areas in which they pushed bipartisan initiatives together. "Senator Schmitt and I worked very well together from opposite sides of the aisle while serving in the Missouri Senate," Chappelle-Nadal told Breitbart News. "He took the lead in the senate to address predatory fines by municipalities shortly after the Ferguson Uprising. Senator Schmitt also supported my legislation giving disadvantaged and minority students educational alternative opportunities." When asked to specify what she meant by "moving mountains," Chappelle-Nadal said: "both Eric and I immensely care about St. Louis County residents and work separately to ensure individual rights are upheld." "It is always more fruitful when opposing parties can work together where there is agreement policy-wise," she added. She also denied being approached by Schmitt or his campaign to conceal the image, adding she tweeted the image "as a nice memory," and provided Breitbart News with additional pictures from "Seersucker Wednesday" (seen below), which she noted is "a bipartisan tradition that continues today." In those pictures, among others, Schmitt and Chappelle-Nadal appear together. In August 2017, after Trump said there was "blame on both sides" for the violence at the Charlottesville Unite the Right rallies, then-State Sen. Chappelle-Nadal (D) took to Facebook and wrote, "I hope Trump is assassinated!," as Breitbart News reported at the time. After public outrage, Chappelle-Nadal apologized and deleted the post, but refused to resign despite bi-partisan censures and calls for her forfeiture of office. "I am not resigning ... What I said was wrong, but I am not going to stop talking about what led to that, which is the frustration and anger that many people across America are feeling right now," she told the St. Louis Post-Dispatch. Chappelle-Nadal's comments led to a U.S. Secret Service investigation into whether her hope that Trump was assassinated was a serious threat or not. It also led to multiple bipartisan calls for her resignation, including from the state's Democratic Party chairman at the time, Stephen Webber, and then-Gov. Eric Greitens (R-MO), a Republican who Schmitt is now running against for the GOP nomination for U.S. Senate. ...
Nonetheless, the mere fact that Schmitt has a penchant of working with such people on big-picture policy items raises serious concerns as to whether he would be just another establishment Republican in the Washington swamp if elected. With the right furious right now at people like Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX) for cutting a gun control deal and Senate GOP leader Sen. [View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zfi0v9svg0ctbuu90sv7tu3jghke9hulc877qmho_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6eo34cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6s36e1rm0sr16djmfcrje5p7ct3n62rjddr5m1rr0t9me6r35c5k6gq70ob7csrt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor5ddkcupbephkcipm9ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zskkpn02r19iksvgr30o1b4b6u9rhsp3dkbbqpb0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6eo34cjh2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziuopl6sf6dvl0n9o66i452ehb5nc720ur2nkuu8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6eo34cjh2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zgdpjdrv2npg3jfv028mem3cqg0vdtjupllo7s3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3h6eo34cjh2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

clean_body: I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A Friend, I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Matter. Now, I know what you're thinking... What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis? I ask, "what about them is influential?!" This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities? No. They aren't, but BLM is. BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations. I saw the hypocrisy long ago. That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. BLEXIT is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support. How I Started BLEXIT I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans. With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me. This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever. I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM. Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others. Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes. BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law. BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them. BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character. BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. Here 's how you can help: I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities. This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter. BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today: HOW BLEXIT Works Step One: We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods. Step Two: We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy. We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time. Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses. As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them. Step Three: Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media. BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families. Step Four: We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities. What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods. Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man. We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods. So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?" It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us. subject: We want to hear from you, Derek
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Sh*t is just too expensive right now.
#
**Sh*t is just too expensive right now.**
You know it. I know it. Everyone knows it.
Just this week, inflation hit another 40 year record high – just like it did last month. The price of gas, groceries, and just about everything has skyrocketed.
I mean, filling up my RAM is now costing over $100 every time...
[](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/jf-inflation-story-email/?amount=5&refcode=em20220714-6516&akid=6516%2E434096%2Eg1MAR3)
I’m just like, REALLY?!??
Working families are paying more almost everywhere. I see it every time I go to Aldi's or Giant Eagle. Things are way too expensive and it’s hurting people across the Commonwealth.
[**_If inflation has caused you to have to choose between family time or an extra shift at work, groceries or gas, or make any other difficult financial decision, can you take a moment to share your story?_**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/jf-inflation-story-email/?source=em20220714-6516&akid=6516%2E434096%2Eg1MAR3)
I want to collect real stories from real people about how inflation is affecting their lives so we can show the folks in D.C. that they need to crack down on price gouging now.
**[Share your story »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/jf-inflation-story-email/?source=em20220714-6516&akid=6516%2E434096%2Eg1MAR3)**
My opponent, multi-millionaire celebrity doctor Dr. Oz, surely doesn’t notice these sky high prices.
When you own nine homes and have a $48 million dollar mansion, you don’t have to worry about the gas or grocery bill. Paying an extra $10, $20, or $30 for gas or groceries means nothing to him.
But it matters to the rest of us.
Dr. Oz won’t stand up to the special interests and corporate executives who are raising prices on us, but I will.
I am going to go to Washington to fight to bring down prices. We need bold action NOW to make more shit in America, fix our broken supply chains, and take on corporate greed to bring down the cost of everything, for everyone.
[**_How are sky-high prices affecting you? Please take a moment to share your story, I’d absolutely love to hear from you, Derek._**](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/jf-inflation-story-email/?source=em20220714-6516&akid=6516%2E434096%2Eg1MAR3)
**[Share your story »](https://act.johnfetterman.com/survey/jf-inflation-story-email/?source=em20220714-6516&akid=6516%2E434096%2Eg1MAR3)**
Thanks for taking the time,
❤️ John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of PA

| | | Hi team, Earlier today, we announced that we raised over $780,000 in the first 100 days of this campaign **because****of your generous support.** That's more than **$7,800 a day!** I wanted you to be one of the first to know because **we****could not have done this without you**. Thank you! The outpouring of support from every corner of the Houston community (and beyond) has been overwhelming. **As a result of your generosity, we are building a strong campaign foundation and infrastructure that will help us win this race and realize our shared vision for Houston.** We ended the June 30th reporting period with over $715,000 cash on hand in our campaign coffers, which includes about $40,000 from my last City Council campaign. **This is a powerful position to hold after just three months on the campaign trail.** Today, we are celebrating and thanking our supporters. **Tomorrow we get back to building our base and growing our foundation of support.** And together, we will propel this campaign to the next level and elect the next mayor of Houston with the experience and vision that will ensure every Houstonian has the opportunity to thrive. **Thank you for your support!** Sincerely, Amanda K. Edwards

name: Diane DeLuzio
subject: Mark DeLuzio gets another key endorsement
body:
## FreedomWorks for America Endorses Mark DeLuzio in Arizona’s Second Congressional District
July 12, 2022
**WASHINGTON, D.C. —** FreedomWorks for America is proud to endorse Mark DeLuzio in Arizona’s new second congressional district.
“Mark DeLuzio is a patriot who has lived the American Dream. Now, he is running for Congress to help fight for and preserve that Dream for others,” **commented** **Noah Wall, FreedomWorks for America Executive Director. **“From his achievements in the business world to his success in working with the Federal Trade Commission to save countless American jobs from being outsourced to China, Mark’s impact on his Arizona community and country at large has been extraordinary. Just imagine what more he could accomplish if elected to Congress.”
“Mark will fight to protect law enforcement, secure our borders, and combat inflation immediately upon arrival in D.C. Life in Joe Biden’s America is expensive, dangerous, and difficult, but the White House and its allies refuse to own up to their failures. Arizonans are eager for bold leadership, and this new district provides an excellent opportunity to elect a bold, principled conservative. FreedomWorks for America is excited to throw our full support behind Mark as he fights not only for Arizonans, but for all Americans.”
Regards,

Diane DeLuzio

DELUZIO FOR CONGRESS
P.O. Box 10043
PRESCOTT, AZ 86304

name: Chief Demings
subject: my mother's words:"never tire of doing good, Val,"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
I am determined to meet this moment, to win, to never tire of doing good
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive 2022 race for the U.S. Senate – a race that can decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even if the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even today – as I reflect about my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47837849/355838937/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3740-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMTlkYmNiYy1iMzAzLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=S8qlJyESrlnaDv0o08hv7qF5QvlU21XtNtYiiZpSz5g=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law.
My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor growing up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police. And friend, I know firsthand there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zhehqq13mjbnk6c1eeh1im86lcs6gaacu572cqi8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3j60or4cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65spmeppjbcjks5qnepbks1grcddic5q72tllmaq31c34esqe4s31c1rj5d36mdgefkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj33cllmhg75c3664qb6or7m2qmash5u)
[](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zevn1c2s1eghi7fa2q2a9pjsu18sa5kg28hgf1n0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3j60or4cdh2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6oen1o18ftu1tgm2hkc7jc50csd0ng6ejq2gri8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3j60or4cdh2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfg6tcsujskrrbh19onds1ck8am8a29ec5nvso30_rp22sh2s8i66pb7c3j60or4cdh2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

body:
Team, take it from someone who lost an election this year.
| | | [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=da27e1a83b&e=007b353608) [](https://barriertoentrypac.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=cb795e0b9271d112fbc5c1bd8&id=c118fc11ab&e=007b353608)

Hey Team, this is Jessica Mason. Below is a long personal message I wrote while reflecting. _Thanks in advance for taking the time to hear me out.

_ It’s definitely been an exciting midterm election year for Barrier to Entry. We’ve had some incredible election victories across the country like Shenise Turner-Sloss in Ohio, Jamie McLeod-Skinner in Oregon, Shaquana Boykin in New York, and more. And we’ve also endured some pretty heartbreaking losses like Kimi Cole in Nevada, Joe Thompson in California, and myself.

**Take it from me, a former B/E candidate who didn’t win my primary election for Congress in TX-30 this March: I know how bad it hurts to lose.** But coming from a low-income, working-class background with little resources and refusing to accept any corporate money, I never would have been able to run as competitive a campaign as I did without B/E and all of our grassroots supporters like you. So despite walking away without a victory this time around, I'm proud of the work we did and the momentum we built from the ground up. We mobilized, we organized, and we put our hearts into an honest race that represented our values. And I’m confident that we had a meaningful impact on the progressive movement and am hopeful that it inspired other young, poor Black kids across the country that they can run, too.

**My point is that there will always be ups and downs — it comes with the territory when shaking the ground up for progressive change.** We’re in this fight for the underdogs, the candidates that are written off, the ones who don’t have the advantages or privileges, the leaders championing ambitious policies that others label as "too bold". _Because we know that it takes guts and grit and bravery to challenge the status quo and demand better.

_ So we know it’s not easy work, and we know the barriers that these types of low-income and underfunded candidates are up against. **But we do this because we also know how critical it is to have actual working-class people representing the working class.** With everything going on our country, from abortion rights being dismantled to gun violence running rampant, the last thing we need is more out-of-touch corporate elitist politicians making the life decisions that impact us and our livelihoods. With so much at stake, we MUST keep fighting if we want to see change.

After my primary, I took some time off for myself to focus on my mental health. Then, I came right back into things ready to break barriers as B/E’s Director of Campaigns so that I could help uplift other progressive candidates like me who have what it takes to make a difference in their communities but lack the necessary resources and funding. **However, right now, I’m getting worried that we might have to scale back and limit what we’re able to provide for our candidates because we’re falling behind on our fundraising numbers.

** That’s why I’m asking you sincerely and personally today if you would consider donating any amount right now to help us support our working-class progressive candidates as they struggle to pave their way in a political space that favors those who already have the upper hand. **[We need to raise $6,915 by tomorrow’s urgent mid-month deadline if we’re going to get back on track — will you help us hit this critical goal by donating $25 or any amount right now? ---
She spent 11 years as America’s favorite type-A mom on the hit TV show "Modern Family," and now she’s spending an hour with Kasich & Klepper to discuss everything from swearing off dating to whether golf is a skill (and not a sport) to getting deep about the youth mental health crisis. Julie also discusses the power of Modern Family: how the show spoke across the political aisle and what it means when a show has run its course.

---
Former NASA astronaut Mike Massimino spoke about the precious “pale blue dot” we all live on, the importance of keeping it safe, and how Earth’s future is tied to the stars. Mike also shares his thoughts on private space programs like SpaceX, Blue Origin, and the commercialization of space travel by billionaires like Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, and Richard Branson.

In this episode, America’s Doctor answers questions about the continuing COVID health crisis including the need for continued response funding, COVID best practices, and the future of the pandemic. He also talks about the epidemic of loneliness and isolation among Americans, the youth mental health crisis, and how connection can help serve as an antidote to those problems.

Global warming, more COVID, Putin’s endless escalation of war, growing inflation... The world’s on fire, literally, so how do we fight it? Ian Bremmer, the (ever-optimistic) political scientist and bestselling author shares with Kasich and Klepper why he believes the crisis in Ukraine is the beginning of a new Cold War with Russia, the urgency of Finland and Sweden to join NATO, and how Putin has dug himself a hole with no way out.

clean_body: Earlier this year, I launched a new podcast, "Kasich & Klepper" with The Daily Show's Jordan Klepper| | | | | | | Peter, you may have seen my recent email about my new podcast, "" with The Daily Show's Jordan Klepper. Below you will find links to some of our highest-rated interviews that I think you will find very entertaining and thought-provoking. While the links are for episodes on Apple Podcasts, you can also find all of them on Spotify or other podcast platforms by searching for, "Kasich & Klepper" If you like what you hear, please take a moment to leave us a positive review on iTunes to help us grow our audience! | : She spent 11 years as America’s favorite type-A mom on the hit TV show "Modern Family," and now she’s spending an hour with Kasich & Klepper to discuss everything from swearing off dating to whether golf is a skill (and not a sport) to getting deep about the youth mental health crisis. Julie also discusses the power of Modern Family: how the show spoke across the political aisle and what it means when a show has run its course. | : Rock and Roll Hall of Fame musician and iconic actor, Stevie Van Zandt chats about music, being stuck in the 60's “renaissance,” and bringing arts education to thousands of kids across the United States. Plus, he discusses the role of activism in his career and his real-life consigliere attitude when it comes to fame. | : Former NASA astronaut Mike Massimino spoke about the precious “pale blue dot” we all live on, the importance of keeping it safe, and how Earth’s future is tied to the stars. Mike also shares his thoughts on private space programs like SpaceX, Blue Origin, and the commercialization of space travel by billionaires like Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, and Richard Branson. | : In this episode, America’s Doctor answers questions about the continuing COVID health crisis including the need for continued response funding, COVID best practices, and the future of the pandemic. He also talks about the epidemic of loneliness and isolation among Americans, the youth mental health crisis, and how connection can help serve as an antidote to those problems. | : Global warming, more COVID, Putin’s endless escalation of war, growing inflation... The world’s on fire, literally, so how do we fight it? Ian Bremmer, the (ever-optimistic) political scientist and bestselling author shares with Kasich and Klepper why he believes the crisis in Ukraine is the beginning of a new Cold War with Russia, the urgency of Finland and Sweden to join NATO, and how Putin has dug himself a hole with no way out. | I hope you'll enjoy listening to the podcast as much as I have enjoyed hosting it with Jordan and our partners at Treefort Media. Stay tuned for more updates in the near future. Thank you! -John | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | | | If you no longer wish to receive these emails, .

| Hey, Mark Brnovich checking in...

As the Attorney General of Arizona, I’ve fought for Arizona in the Supreme Court against the Biden Administration several times.

Well, I guess they’re bored—because they’re back at it.

This time—they’re suing the state of Arizona for... wait for it...

**Requiring proof of U.S. citizenship to vote.**

I’m not kidding.

The Biden Administration is literally _suing Arizona_ because we think you should have to be an American citizen to vote in an election.
---
|
---
| Really, this lawsuit is truly meme-worthy (and I don’t even meme).

**So let’s get this straight: **

The Democrats think it’s not just ok, but GREAT for non-citizens to vote in _our_ elections?

The answer is a big, stinking yes.

In fact, the New York State Supreme court just struck down a New York law that would have allowed 800,000 non-citizens to vote.

Their motivation is obvious...

If they hand out entitlements to illegal immigrants and then legalize non-citizen voting rights...

They can buy and import millions of votes for Democrats.

Crazy, right?

**Still, I can’t help but wonder why the Democrats think this is a winning policy proposal?**

You would have to be completely out of touch _and delusional_ to think it makes _any sense_ for non-citizens to vote in American elections.

And you’d have to be even crazier to think that the majority of Americans support this.

We don’t...

But unless there are strong voices of opposition in Washington D.C...

I don’t see the Dems stopping this madness anytime soon.

That’s why I’m running for the U.S. Senate...

**And it’s why I need your help.**

If you haven’t already, I would LOVE for you [**to help volunteer with my campaign**](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=514c2a858a&e=6dcd2506d1)**.**

Even if you’ve only got an hour a week, we need all the help we can get...

And you can play a HUGE role in keeping our elections fair and free.

\- Mark

The consequences of the Supreme Court's decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ have been immediate and _**awful**_**.**
Take the case of a TEN-YEAR-OLD GIRL in Ohio who was forced to travel out of state for an abortion after she was raped -- because she was just three days over the six-week abortion ban.
**That story is terrible enough on its own. But the Republican response to it has been _even worse._**
The governor of South Dakota suggested that the child should be forced to carry the pregnancy to term. And since they didn't want to deal with the morality of forcing a child to give birth, other Republicans chose to pretend like it wasn't true. Tucker Carlson and other Fox News hosts claimed it was untrue to their millions of viewers -- as did Congressman Jim Jordan on his Twitter.
**This is a disgusting denial of this girl 's humanity. It's also _exactly_ what we must expect from radical Republicans in the new post-Roe America.**
We can't have public officials in office who deny women their own bodily autonomy. You can make sure we elect unapologetically pro-choice, pro-human women in 2022 by [chipping in here](https://act.myngp.com/el/BOemRW6zwyt1wBo7-c9GEgD_dd3iVoJC1WG8W4D_FeI=/6bQ51akv5NSZgWFGjkvyMzBIG2b99opihz3izg-KuGA=?refcode=X_071422_OhioGirl).

body:
But most of it won't happen without these changes! Comment today!
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-FERC-get-grid-ready-clean-energy/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&t=2&akid=13045%2E53494%2EaeZ-VS) | _Today's action is part of Evergreen's**100% Clean Power Campaign.** Together, we're mobilizing support for policies that will rapidly accelerate a just transition to a clean energy future.
Interested? [_**Act today to stay in the loop!**_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-FERC-get-grid-ready-clean-energy/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&t=3&akid=13045%2E53494%2EaeZ-VS)_
---
Friend,
Right now, there are enough planned clean energy projects to power 84% of the country. But they're facing an existential threat—our existing power grid isn't equipped to handle it. That's bad for our climate _and_ for our economy.
As we transition to clean power, we're going to need to move energy from the windiest, sunniest parts of the country to the rest of it. That means we're going to need more transmission lines to carry that clean energy from where it's created to where it's used, or else all the solar and wind in the world won't help us.
But there's good news: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) is considering new rules that require utilities to start planning now for a long-term clean energy grid. **This change is essential to our clean energy future—[ _sign an official public comment right now, and we'll deliver it to FERC decision-makers!_](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-FERC-get-grid-ready-clean-energy/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&t=4&akid=13045%2E53494%2EaeZ-VS)**
[SIGN ON](https://act.evergreenaction.com/letter/tell-FERC-get-grid-ready-clean-energy/?utm_source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&source=ema_2022-07-14_FERC_rule_grid_comment_&t=5&akid=13045%2E53494%2EaeZ-VS)

The biggest bottleneck for clean energy? Not enough power lines. But FERC's proposed rule will break this logjam by helping lay out who pays for the lines, where they go, and how they're planned.

Together, we're mobilizing support for policies that will rapidly accelerate a just transition to a clean energy future. Interested? Friend, Right now, there are enough planned clean energy projects to power 84% of the country. But they're facing an existential threat—our existing power grid isn't equipped to handle it. That's bad for our climate and for our economy. As we transition to clean power, we're going to need to move energy from the windiest, sunniest parts of the country to the rest of it. That means we're going to need more transmission lines to carry that clean energy from where it's created to where it's used, or else all the solar and wind in the world won't help us. But there's good news: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) is considering new rules that require utilities to start planning now for a long-term clean energy grid. This change is essential to our clean energy future— The biggest bottleneck for clean energy? Not enough power lines. But FERC's proposed rule will break this logjam by helping lay out who pays for the lines, where they go, and how they're planned. Thanks to advocates like you, a clean energy future lies ahead of us. Now we need to call on FERC to make sure the grid is ready. Together, Lena Moffitt Chief of Staff, Evergreen Action

name: Jared Moskowitz
subject: January 6th
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jared Moskowitz for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

We knew it before, but the January 6th hearings confirm that President Trump supported a direct attack on the core of our democracy. Watching these hearings reminds me how disgusted I felt while watching the insurrection last year. No American should feel that way about our country.

Trumpism has taken hold of the Republican Party, and we cannot stand idly by as they attack our rights, subvert the rule of law, and attempt to steal our democracy.

We need leaders who will fight back.

This is about more than January 6th. It’s about a growing culture of white supremacy, antisemitism, and hate. It’s about how authoritarian leaders like Trump feed off and spread misinformation to serve their own ends.

They want to diminish voting rights to keep themselves in power. They want to gaslight us so they can take away essential programs like Social Security and Medicare and remake the country with their broken values. They want to keep us tired and scared because they think we will go along with their plans.

They’re wrong.

More than ever before, we need pro-democracy, anti-violence champions in Congress. I promise that I will never waver in fighting back against these threats. That means gun safety. It means protecting voting rights. And it means fighting for justice and equality at every turn.

This is about our future and our values. I hope you’ll stand with me in the fight.

In Solidarity,
Jared

subject: Did you see my wife’s last email?
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Dear Peter,
I just wanted to make sure you saw the last email from my darling wife Annie. Over our four decades of marriage, she’s been my North Star, an incredible mother to our children, and my very best friend. There’s no one I’d rather have by my side, and I know that she will make an incredible First Lady of Maryland.
If you are able, I am urging you to chip in whatever you can to help us meet our critical fundraising goal of $15,000 by tomorrow’s 11:59 PM deadline. Our people-powered movement relies on supporters like you to help bring about the change that our state needs and deserves. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=20.22]
Thank you,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]
Forwarded Message Below:
In case I haven’t had a chance to introduce myself to you yet, I’m Anne Maher, Peter’s wife of 41 incredible years.
Since Peter’s campaign for Governor first began, I’ve had an amazing experience meeting so many of his supporters on the campaign trail. Whether we’re meeting at farmers’ markets, parks and parades, on neighborhood main streets, or at small local businesses, the stories that all of you have shared with me have been a true highlight of this past year. Peter is building a people-powered movement to create a people-centered government, and he’ll make sure all of your voices will be heard and represented under his gubernatorial administration.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=20.22]
Peter is fired up and ready to win the Democratic nomination on election day -- but he needs your help to get there! Right now, Peter and his team are working hard to meet their critical fundraising deadline on July 15. If you believe in Peter’s bold vision of results-oriented service, will you chip in to help him meet his fundraising goal of $15,000 by tomorrow’s 11:59 PM deadline?
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=10]

CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2]
In these final days of the primary race, every dollar raised towards our goal will amplify our campaign’s efforts to reach out to voters. We need Peter as our next Governor, and we need you to help us reach our fundraising goal to make that happen!
My husband is humbled and honored by the trust that you place in him every day, and I know that he will never let you down as Maryland’s next Governor. I can’t thank you enough for your continued support of our movement. Thanks to supporters like you, Peter’s team is closer to the finish line than any other candidate in this race.
With your help, we’re going to secure the Democratic nomination, win the General Election in November, and deliver the concrete points of progress to lift all of Maryland’s communities into the high quality of life that they deserve. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/julymidmonth_0714?refcode=kicker2&amount=20.22]
Onwards to victory,
Anne

name: Peter Welch
subject: Wall Street, K Street, or Bridge Street?
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY WELCH FOR VERMONT
body:
I got to know—and fell in love with—Vermont values: self-reliance, mutual support, and cooperation built on trust.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=662%2E61531%2EkrX-HA)
Hello,
When my friends and I were graduating from law school, a lot of them were choosing between working on Wall Street or K Street.
I picked a job on Bridge Street in White River Junction instead, far from those big finance and lobbying hubs—and it was one of the best decisions I ever made.
I still remember my first-day-of-work jitters. I didn’t know anyone in town, but before long, White River Junction became home. It’s where I started my career, and it’s where I got to know—and fell in love with—Vermont values: self-reliance, mutual support, and cooperation built on trust.
There’s so much to love about Vermont. It is full of natural beauty and hardworking people fighting for their families every day. It’s the honor of my life to represent this state in Congress.
And now I’m asking this team to come together to help ensure we keep this seat—and the Senate—in Democratic hands. There’s a lot on the line, and we have a lot of work to do.
[**That’s why I’m asking: Can you pitch in $5 to this critically important Senate race today?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3455?t=3&akid=662%2E61531%2EkrX-HA)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

---

| [OTHER](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3455?t=13&akid=662%2E61531%2EkrX-HA)
---

---
I’m always inspired by the way Vermonters come together to solve problems. We focus on solutions, not who gets the credit. **That’s the Vermont way**. That’s how I’ve gotten things done as Vermont’s congressman, and how I’ll get things done if I’m elected to the Senate.
But Mitch McConnell and the Senate Republicans see things differently. They divide people for their own political gain instead of working across the aisle to get things done for working families. They’re fighting for failure, and that won’t change if they retake the majority.
**I’m focused on ensuring Vermont’s working families can get quality, affordable child care and paid family leave, passing a Green New Deal, lowering health care and prescription drug costs, enshrining the right to abortion in federal law, protecting voting rights and our democracy, and delivering results.**
**But none of that can happen if we lose this race.**
[**If you can, please help power this Senate campaign with a $5 donation or anything you can spare today.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3455?t=7&akid=662%2E61531%2EkrX-HA)
Thanks so much,
Peter

body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Mat
[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3156f7d37fcd433bbf1c8f3393a77293&_e=MAC1IyQF4Zm0W4rAPicABZEH-2ynN1ispCf8e2rNh-r1spaZVmXzdMxg0R1DAI9JXwmdo-LQANHGmHyBWJg4HXAwuYG3UKX3mD-wWBFBgMR90cKHA2b98sGswiDebM2m6DDgK2alzGX13775gwkX9bn_2oPYm_hzYUC3lagojAFCHRiiFLAD7y-EdldP8JhaiEwxIvxc2abkGH06Nd-b2DHs23q6JQHG9O0yJ3vDtfnV5LXx1ZkqS-7mMCU11TSJw8NUy1bYMIMtfxRedxE6eForVUWH4ce5mkl0plA1e2U2Vp0RifaDliAh-L-I-ecZWPFzAUyaHET8BSB63HVzuGUvdzWmbHqGTpVr7IfJpZc%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3156f7d37fcd433bbf1c8f3393a77293&_e=MAC1IyQF4Zm0W4rAPicABZEH-2ynN1ispCf8e2rNh-r1spaZVmXzdMxg0R1DAI9JXwmdo-LQANHGmHyBWJg4HXAwuYG3UKX3mD-wWBFBgMR90cKHA2b98sGswiDebM2m6DDgK2alzGX13775gwkX9Te-qAFfoJKZPjJf8lBO1pYUQetft5Rlk3w2AZQVXK5-REiGGUXMM1CTWKYJuaiW-TNEVOMr5GdQ-ILIkBSA1pZuCQDfIdnWnsq-rJi073vLZru6HHqtB9Fijunq8ceOLu4ldbs06MBrsm_n_rhhQ4JbfKmv-DPGiWv-E25ouK4wlWygdzj7tHqjKDn7lJHqlU2PzwEiPo5sA5PyEOWRjbw%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3156f7d37fcd433bbf1c8f3393a77293&_e=MAC1IyQF4Zm0W4rAPicABZEH-2ynN1ispCf8e2rNh-r1spaZVmXzdMxg0R1DAI9JXwmdo-LQANHGmHyBWJg4HXAwuYG3UKX3mD-wWBFBgMR90cKHA2b98sGswiDebM2m6DDgK2alzGX13775gwkX9YEPSrV68FqSQaTK4VAYk_ITC9jgo0liCTZgrIGjU_nk54BldKTOmYVXJ3UImopr2F70naqMAczmNBdyQOMN7_QAdsAUfiGVMdJQ_B5Wy8a6UbnrDmm44e3VePmfkx5WftXfkv_uk61AmbjGQ0CoASk3HUipiVfn_LxO2_qXxmkQvXhCZlBpuydf0lhRbCQYyN-jWRZKKrwzQai_dV5RxUI%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3156f7d37fcd433bbf1c8f3393a77293&_e=MAC1IyQF4Zm0W4rAPicABZEH-2ynN1ispCf8e2rNh-r1spaZVmXzdMxg0R1DAI9JXwmdo-LQANHGmHyBWJg4HXAwuYG3UKX3mD-wWBFBgMR90cKHA2b98sGswiDebM2mcdxXpCQHQpxUmTXjILNK_04CFQYGFD13J_zww2vkFyqJtkut2FVxtQtHs89yqCpggIW3iNPSm6cPD94gIvqUJDj9Zz8M_xJB6ODdjx2sZ3HsRFvV-Z43W84LlEQMk_3Cvh3n2d9g-9hqiQPDijolAOHvH0ErMwuD2FwBRgtyMHyOhSK4MehbuZWp_OhfDYkr4kb5aDdFIRliMsnK5aVuUDOU5gQoVucKaitW2mEhcTA%3D)

body:
Friend, The Democrat party is truly falling apart. We are barely two years into Biden’s disastrous presidency, and **he has already lost the support of his own base.** A recent poll found that [**64% of Democrats want someone other than Biden**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd65x-kgtE5mgPY_mhiw2_iqb4u6hthFUGx5tolIDBnaQVYMwXBq2INwC1dCatNvK-hRujtSj3y0oZ2Jzl6HCJnc&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_reject_biden_v1&n=1) to run in 2024, while a mere 26% think he should be nominated again. **This is Biden’s America:** the economy plummeting while crime skyrockets. Americans choosing whether to buy groceries or gas. A weak presence on the international stage. We’ve seen it all along, but some Democrats are finally opening their eyes. Biden has been losing traction ever since he was elected. Now, with a **perilous approval rating of 33%** and 75% of voters saying our country is headed in the wrong direction, we might actually have a shot in 2024 at defeating the most abysmal president in modern American history. **Friend, we still have a fight to win right now in 2022.** It is absolutely imperative that we send a clear message this fall: **that Wisconsin needs and deserves conservative fighters who fight for them in Washington and in Madison.** That’s why we need to focus on removing Tony Evers from the governor’s mansion and sending Senator Ron Johnson back to D.C. **We can win this fight, but we can’t do it alone.** [Would you be willing to contribute as little as $5 to our efforts? Your help is very appreciated as we fight for freedom this November. ](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDVnZosEoUEKHstNh4vkJdv5kZKlDl_o-kofI2Q8OQNSag&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dems_reject_biden_v1&n=2) Thank you for everything, Team WisGOP

body:
TL;DR
#
Derek, as soon as we saw this, we knew we had to reach out.
The Daily Beast just dropped an exposé on how Dr. Oz benefits from _Citizens United_ \+ has a shady super PAC to take in MILLIONS of anonymous donations.
Honestly, the first paragraph sums it up:
> Celebrity doctor and Republican Senate candidate Mehmet Oz has plenty of personal wealth to help fund his upstart campaign. And while the TV doctor might be a political neophyte, his fundraising operation has incorporated a sophisticated technique—what one expert described as **“legalized money laundering.”**
Seriously???
My dude Dr. Oz really just couldn’t stop at a super PAC. Apparently, he’s got some combo super-PAC-slash-nonprofit that allows him to take unlimited cash without saying who it’s from. 🤢
**This isn’t what our politics should look like, Derek.**
Campaigns should be funded by YOU, the people, NOT special interests. That’s why we’ve worked so hard to earn your support + build our rockstar team of grassroots donors. Meanwhile, Oz is funding his candidacy with shady dark money, not to mention the fortune he made from hawking diet pills + quack medicine on TV.
**Dr. Oz goes against everything we stand for.** So here’s the deal. We’re going to send him packing back to New Jersey.
[**_If you believe that Pennsylvania’s next U.S. Senator should champion the interests of working people — not corporations or random ultra-rich dudes — will you please chip in $5 towards our grassroots campaign today?_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220714-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220714-6522&refcode2=6522_434096_P1C9A5&akid=6522%2E434096%2EP1C9A5)

Our campaign is about fighting for working families from *every single one* of Pennsylvania's 67 counties. Unlike Dr. Oz, John won’t sacrifice his values for cash.

#
Hey Peter Willis, A few weeks ago, I hosted a candid discussion with a few of my friends, and I want to thank everyone who attended. It was everything that we expected and so much more. We discussed Roe V Wade, gun laws, how to create jobs in the district, and healthcare reform. Trust me; this was a much-needed discussion because we are in this together. Your issues are my concerns, and your voice is so important. This event was so unique that I felt we needed another one, and I would love for you to be there. Gail Buckner, a longtime friend, is hosting our next event, and our special guest speaker, Charlie Bailey, Georgia's next Lieutenant Governor, will join us! You will want to meet Charlie, and I also want you to be there as my special guest. Please register to ensure that we can accommodate all attendees. I’m running because my career has shown me time and time again that democracies are fragile, and I know that ours is under attack.

I’m running because my children’s generation deserves to experience the same kind of natural beauty I’ve seen on all my travels and right here in WI - but the existential threat of climate change is putting their future in peril.

I’m running because this is not a time when anyone can sit back and relax, and I’ve always stood up to serve when needed.

| | | Annie has been hitting the road across the Lowcountry to hear from members of our community about their top priorities.

It’s clear that the residents of SC-1 are ready for change. While our MAGA opponent, Nancy Mace, ignores the issues facing Lowcountry families, Annie is focused on addressing gun violence, protecting abortion access, and more.

Bottom line: Annie is committed to delivering for Lowcountry families. _She will always fight for you in Congress._

**Check out what Annie has been up to over the last few weeks.**

In Congress, Annie will always defend the right to choose following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe vs. Wade.

name: Team AOC
subject: Desperate for good men
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
Yesterday Alexandria was walking up the steps of the Capitol when a man made inappropriate sexist and racist comments to her.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220714-3217-header&t=1&akid=3217%2E2526796%2EXDALP5)
Yesterday Alexandria was walking up the steps of the Capitol when a man made inappropriate sexist and racist comments to her right in front of Capitol police officers.1 The officers did nothing. They didn’t even ask the guy to take a step back.
Not only did this incident resurface serious concerns about why so little is done to protect the women of color who serve in the Capitol, but it also raises a larger question about **why men too often just stand by when they see other men catcalling and accosting women.**
So many men know or are friends with people like this man and just shrug off their behavior or ignore it because they don’t know what else to do in the moment.
But we know that this kind of behavior often escalates and tracks with domestic abuse, stalking, and assault.
**So last night Alexandria went to Instagram and asked to hear from men: How have you grappled with this issue? Has another man’s behavior ever made you uncomfortable, and did you respond in the moment? If you didn’t know how to respond in the past, do you respond now?**
[**Please share your thoughts with us here and we’ll share some of the responses we get so we can all learn how to intervene in these situations.**](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/survey/how-to-intervene/?source=em20220714-3217-P_ENG_SUR_MIS&t=2&akid=3217%2E2526796%2EXDALP5)

clean_body: Yesterday Alexandria was walking up the steps of the Capitol when a man made inappropriate sexist and racist comments to her. Yesterday Alexandria was walking up the steps of the Capitol when a man made inappropriate sexist and racist comments to her right in front of Capitol police officers.1 The officers did nothing. They didn’t even ask the guy to take a step back. Not only did this incident resurface serious concerns about why so little is done to protect the women of color who serve in the Capitol, but it also raises a larger question about why men too often just stand by when they see other men catcalling and accosting women. So many men know or are friends with people like this man and just shrug off their behavior or ignore it because they don’t know what else to do in the moment. But we know that this kind of behavior often escalates and tracks with domestic abuse, stalking, and assault. So last night Alexandria went to Instagram and asked to hear from men: How have you grappled with this issue? Has another man’s behavior ever made you uncomfortable, and did you respond in the moment? If you didn’t know how to respond in the past, do you respond now? Fellow Conservative,I’m happy to share some good news with you!Thanks to your prayers and generous support, my campaign has been permanently restored to the ballot in my election bid here in Florida’s 14th Congressional District.I am the frontrunner in primary race, and my campaign is poised to win on August 23rd before we take out Kathy Castor, the anti-police, anti-law-and-order Democrat incumbent in November.**But I still need your help**.Thanks to the state’s errors, we had to pay $40,000 in legal fees, significantly depleting our war chest to defeat Kathy Castor.[I’m asking you today to contribute generously to my Legal Defense Fund and help me recoup those massive costs](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=1e47c9e680&e=00028e5542).It’s no secret what happened here.The bureaucrats who work with the Division of Elections are Democrats, and they’re doing the bidding of Kathy Castor because they know I’m a major threat.Not only do we have to beat Castor, but we must beat her cronies in the bloated state government, too.[That’s why I need you to chip into my Legal Defense Fund today](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=6729b48dbc&e=00028e5542).At this point, there is no more pending litigation.I’ve won my case. It will not be dragged on indefinitely.[I just need your help to recoup what it these Democrats cost us with their dirty tricks as I march forward in this campaign](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=d03b32849c&e=00028e5542).[Show me you have my back by chipping in $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to my Legal Defense Fund and tell the Democrats that they can’t stop the Judge campaign](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=0d0aa258a3&e=00028e5542)!Thank you in advance for your generosity.Respectfully,James Judge
Republican for U.S. Congress
Florida’s 14th Congressional District**P.S.** I’ve got a real chance to defeat one of the furthest-left Democrats in Congress.Now that my name will surely be on the ballot, I need your support more than ever.[So, contribute generously to my Legal Defense Fund in this crucial time, when my campaign needs it the most](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5215cf0ab3&e=00028e5542).After you do that, I kindly ask that you forward this message to all of your patriotic friends and ask them to do the same!

# Dear Peter,

Inflation rose a staggering 9.1% in June.

The cost of gas, food and everyday goods continues to rise and is hurting hardworking Marylanders.

**The Democrats running for governor are proposing government programs that will continue to drive inflation. Programs that Marylanders simply cannot afford.**

That's why today I released a new ad. Meet The Unaffordables.
---
| [ ](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=0631fbcd00&e=64ac72257a)
---
| **Maryland can't afford one-party rule in Annapolis. **

_I am running for governor to stand up to tax increases and to fight for tax cuts for hardworking Marylanders. That starts with repealing the Inflation Tax and eliminating retirement taxes._

As your governor I will continue to grow the economy, create opportunity, and create jobs.

Because the most important thing to me is standing up for you and your family.

[**Will you join me?**](https://kellyschulzforgovernor.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05f3d1aa190e2cb084d25c5f0&id=0051d3f9fc&e=64ac72257a)

Thank you,

clean_body: | | | | Dear Friend, Inflation rose a staggering 9.1% in June. The cost of gas, food and everyday goods continues to rise and is hurting hardworking Marylanders. The Democrats running for governor are proposing government programs that will continue to drive inflation. Programs that Marylanders simply cannot afford. That's why today I released a new ad. Meet The Unaffordables. Maryland can't afford one-party rule in Annapolis. I am running for governor to stand up to tax increases and to fight for tax cuts for hardworking Marylanders. That starts with repealing the Inflation Tax and eliminating retirement taxes. As your governor I will continue to grow the economy, create opportunity, and create jobs. Because the most important thing to me is standing up for you and your family. Thank you, Kelly Schulz Candidate for Governor | | Follow Us! | "Facebook" | "Twitter" | instagram.com/kellymschulz "Instagram" ---|---|--- Kelly Schulz P.O. | | Friends,

I know many of you are wondering how our campaign against Senator Blumenthal is going, and the answer is fantastic. In case you missed it, earlier this week the Connecticut Citizens Defense League rolled out their ratings in the Senate race and they ended up exactly as you'd expect. Unlike Senator Blumenthal I will proudly defend your right to defend yourself.
---
|
---
|
---
| We had a ton of fun campaign stops this week as well. Last Saturday was filled with events, where we started the day with the American Legion in Trumbull, a lunch at the St. Margaret Shrine in Bridgeport, and then GOP events with both the New London GOP and the Groton RTC. I had a chance to catch up with my old friend Ben Proto as well!.
---
|
---
| On Sunday I joined my friend, and our next Governor, Bob Stefanowski, in Norwich, for a Veterans Town Hall at the VFW building. As your Senator I will fight hard to fix so many of the problems at the VA, because we must always be thankful to those who have served our country and kept us safe. Later on I joined the Ledyard RTC meeting.
---
|
---
| With Inflation now hitting 9.1%, it's time for change in Washington. Unlike Senator Blumenthal, I am ready to fight for the needs of Connecticut families, not big money Democrat donors. Thank you so much for your support for our campaign, and I look forward to seeing you out on the campaign trail soon.

In Service,

Peter Lumaj

P.S. It's going to take a ton of work for us to defeat Blumenthal this November. If you could [chip in a generous gift of $250, $100, $50, or even $25 it'd make a world of difference](https://PeterLumaj.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e4fb4f1b85edd41e1d869424a&id=4afb88006d&e=ad1669c4a3) as we try to get our message out to voters. I can't say enough how grateful I am to all who have been supporting our campaign so far!

| Peter,
Tomorrow is a critical fundraising deadline for our campaign – the first since our end-of-quarter deadline last month.

[Republicans are on pace to Take Back The House this Fall, but it won’t happen unless we can win California’s 47th Congressional District. And, frankly, we’re still more than $15 million behind Katie Porter’s fundraising in this race. → ](https://baughforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c960c16667ac69bd188629a19&id=1e46d7c2d3&e=8a657725d1)

---
| We’re all feeling the economic disaster that Katie Porter and Joe Biden have caused, but I want to highlight one more reason why this race is so important...

_We cannot forget Afghanistan._

Katie Porter cheered as Joe Biden hastily withdrew from Afghanistan, abandoning Americans behind enemy lines and leaving our allies to die at the hands of the Taliban.

Nearly a year later, the media may have moved on, but the consequences of Joe Biden’s actions are ongoing.

Now, we’ve just learned that the Biden Administration is refusing to cooperate with a Congressionally-mandated investigation into the failures there, and at the same time, seeking to unlock frozen Afghan reserves that could end up enriching the Taliban.

Democrats in Congress aren’t doing anything to stop this from happening, and the liberal media certainly won’t provide needed accountability.

This is yet another reason why we must take back the House: to restore American greatness on the world stage and be the beacon for human rights that the greatest Democracy in the world should be.

**If you agree, I am imploring you to help our campaign make up our fundraising deficit before midnight tomorrow. Republicans across the country are counting on us to win → **
