Fellow American,

**Our opponent just announced that he raised more than $17 million between April 1st and June 30th._That's THREE TIMES more than our campaign raised._**

Senator Warnock's fundraising last quarter topped that of his first quarter haul when he brought in $13.6 million - which was _**"the most money ever raised by any U.S. Senate candidate in the first quarter of an election year."**_

We have been outraised by Senator Warnock every single quarter since I got into this race, and despite being among the top fundraisers in the Republican Party, _we can't keep up._

**That's why I'm turning to you.** If you've made a donation prior to today, I'm asking you to make another donation in the same amount or more. If you haven't yet made a donation, we NEED YOU NOW! We've got less than 120 days until Election Day, so time is running out to catch up.

body:

| | | Peter,

The Happy Diner, my dad’s restaurant in Billings, MT, that’s where it all started.

That’s where my dad showed me the true value of a dollar, and it is where I learned that working-class folks like you and I have to scrape the bottom of the pie tin just to make it by.

[__**Can I count on you to chip in $50 to help me fight for working-class folks in Congress?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=8776e8ea9a&e=2f4ec52c5e)

---
| The diner is also where I held my first job at the ripe age of eight! I made 25 cents picking up trash off of the blacktop. That didn’t get me very far as a kid and neither does our federal minimum wage of $7.25 - for adults!

And we know women are paid disproportionately less. Right now too many women in Montana make our state minimum wage - an appalling $8.75. Women in our state are making over 19% less than their male counterparts. Unacceptable.

[__**Will you chip in $50 to make sure we can secure equal pay and a living wage for all Montanans?**__](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=c85ea1083d&e=2f4ec52c5e)

clean_body: The Happy Diner, my dad’s restaurant, that’s where it all started. That’s where my dad showed me the true value of a dollar. | | | | | | | | Peter, The Happy Diner, my dad’s restaurant in Billings, MT, that’s where it all started. That’s where my dad showed me the true value of a dollar, and it is where I learned that working-class folks like you and I have to scrape the bottom of the pie tin just to make it by. | | The diner is also where I held my first job at the ripe age of eight! I made 25 cents picking up trash off of the blacktop. That didn’t get me very far as a kid and neither does our federal minimum wage of $7.25 - for adults! And we know women are paid disproportionately less. Right now too many women in Montana make our state minimum wage - an appalling $8.75. Women in our state are making over 19% less than their male counterparts. Unacceptable. Friend,
---
When I ran for state legislature, I ran against a 30-year incumbent. I was the underdog. When I ran for governor of South Carolina, I was underfunded and far behind in the polls. I was the underdog. I’ve run many campaigns. I’ve been the underdog many times. But I’ve never lost an election. It wasn’t easy. Standing up to the status quo never is. Defeating the longest-serving member of the state legislature was a daunting task. But I put my head down and focused on one thing: _**winning. **_

clean_body: | | | Friend, When I ran for state legislature, I ran against a 30-year incumbent. I was the underdog. When I ran for governor of South Carolina, I was underfunded and far behind in the polls. I was the underdog. I’ve run many campaigns. I’ve been the underdog many times. But I’ve never lost an election. It wasn’t easy. Standing up to the status quo never is. Defeating the longest-serving member of the state legislature was a daunting task. But I put my head down and focused on one thing: winning. | | know what it takes to win. | | | We can’t go into November assuming Republicans will win. Yes, Republicans have the advantage. We have momentum and Democrats are plagued by terrible poll numbers. But it’s not that simple. If it were, Democrats wouldn’t be pouring millions of dollars into districts across the country. | | | Each race — all 435 seats are up in the House and 35 seats are up in the Senate — is driven by real people trying to make an important change. | | | There isn’t going to be a Republican sweep unless we help conservative candidates win their races. That means helping conservatives who are in the lead and underdogs who are often discounted. | | It means fighting for the conservative trailblazers in districts where Democrat incumbents have been in power for 30+ years. | | It means standing beside conservatives who are slowly gaining momentum and edging out Democrats in states no one ever thought could go red. | | | It means fighting for bold conservative leaders who can change the course of America’s future. | | | - Will you join me in helping strong conservative candidates across the country this November? My very best, Nikki Haley | A Note From Nikki: Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad. I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. That’s why I wrote this book. "If You Want Something Done..." is set to be released on October 4.
